Complete the sentence with the rule, fear or conclusion that has made your future feel smaller. Read it once, then safely burn the paper in the fireproof bowl. If burning is unsuitable, tear it into several pieces and dispose of it after the ritual.

On the second piece, draw a simple arrow. At the base of the arrow, write where you are now. Along its centre, write the experience, subject or possibility you want to explore. At its point, write the feeling you hope to create through that journey.

Beneath the arrow, complete these three sentences:

“I am ready to discover…”
“I am willing to move beyond…”
“My first step will be…”

Because Sagittarius is mutable, leave a small section of the page blank. This represents the unknown experiences, people and opportunities that may shape the route. You are choosing a direction while remaining available for discovery.

Hold the paper towards the candlelight without bringing it close to the flame and say:

“I choose a future that expands my experience, strengthens my wisdom and keeps my spirit moving. I trust myself to follow the next true step while allowing the journey to reveal more than I can currently see.”

Place the arrow somewhere visible and complete the first step you named within the next three days.

✦ Sagittarius New Moon Tarot Spread - Following the Wider Path

The Horizon
What new possibility is asking me to look beyond my current circumstances?

The Old Map
Which belief or expectation can no longer guide the journey ahead?

The Inner Compass
What value, truth or desire can help me choose my direction?

The First Step
What practical action will begin moving me towards this experience?

The Unwritten Adventure
What do I need to remain open to as the path develops?

2026-12.title: ✦ 10 December - KEY TRANSIT: Saturn Stations Direct in Aries at 23:31 UK Time
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Review what responsibility has taught you since late July.
✓ Choose one commitment that deserves steady effort over quick results.
✓ Put clearer structure around an independent goal or personal ambition.
✓ Let patience strengthen the action you are preparing to take.
✓ Recognise the progress that has happened quietly behind the scenes.

DON’T
✕ Expect everything to accelerate the moment Saturn changes direction.
✕ Treat a delay as evidence that the goal is no longer possible.
✕ Take on a responsibility simply to prove that you can manage alone.
✕ Speak from frustration when the conversation requires precision.
✕ Rebuild a plan around pressure, comparison or somebody else’s timeline.

Saturn stations direct in Aries late tonight after travelling retrograde since late July. This begins a gradual shift from internal review towards visible development around responsibility, independence, courage and self-leadership. The lessons of recent months may now feel easier to apply, especially where you have been reconsidering what you are prepared to commit to and how you want to direct your own life.

Saturn in Aries asks us to build confidence through action that can be repeated and sustained. A desire to begin something may have been tested by delays, doubts or the need for better preparation. Those experiences have helped expose where enthusiasm needed structure and where fear was being mistaken for practicality. Progress can begin gathering momentum again, although Saturn prefers a measured pace.

Mercury squares Mars while forming a supportive trine with Saturn, creating a mixture of mental impatience and practical focus. You may know exactly what you want to say, although frustration could sharpen the delivery. Organise the message before beginning the conversation. Clear facts, realistic expectations and a calm tone will help your words create movement.

Venus sextiles Mars and squares Pluto, bringing desire, attraction and personal values into sharper focus. You may feel more certain about what deserves your energy or recognise where a connection, financial choice or creative pursuit needs stronger boundaries. Choose what allows desire and self-respect to exist together.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
You may feel both ready to move and aware of how much responsibility the next step will require. Let those feelings exist together. Seriousness can show that something matters deeply, while excitement can remind you why the effort is worthwhile.

Energy
The Capricorn Moon supports practical progress, although Saturn’s station may make the atmosphere feel slower or heavier. Choose one task with a clear finish point and complete it steadily. Consistency will carry more power than attempting to force a dramatic breakthrough.

Relationships
Expectations around effort, commitment or independence may need discussing. Be specific about what you can offer and what you need in return. A mature conversation can strengthen a connection when both people are willing to take responsibility for their part.

Work and Purpose
Return to a goal that required more preparation than you originally expected. Update the timeline, define the next milestone and decide what regular action will support it. The plan can now reflect everything the recent review period has taught you.

Spiritual Growth
Consider how your relationship with courage has changed since late July. You may have learnt that bravery includes patience, preparation and the willingness to begin again with greater self-awareness. Let your next action reflect that deeper understanding.

Collective Energy
There may be growing pressure to demonstrate progress or take decisive action. Saturn reminds us that meaningful change is built through responsibility and endurance. The collective task is to create foundations strong enough to support the future we are trying to reach.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Use today to turn one personal ambition into a commitment you can realistically maintain. Review what has changed since late July, identify the lesson that improved your approach and update the structure surrounding the goal. Choose a pace that protects your energy and allows you to build confidence through evidence. Saturn’s direct movement will unfold gradually, so there is no need to force immediate results. The most valuable decision will be the one you are still willing and able to honour when the initial motivation has settled.

2026-12.title: ✦ 11 December - Give the Idea a Shape
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Turn one promising idea into a sequence you can actually follow.
✓ Prepare what you want to say before an important conversation.
✓ Use creativity to make a practical task more enjoyable.
✓ Let attraction or enthusiasm motivate meaningful participation.
✓ Recognise where experience has made you wiser and more capable.

DON’T
✕ Rush somebody because their decision is taking longer than yours.
✕ Turn useful feedback into a judgement about your ability.
✕ Make the plan so strict that it leaves no room for real life.
✕ Use productivity to avoid addressing an emotional undercurrent.
✕ Assume that intensity automatically means something is sustainable.

Mercury forms an exact trine with newly direct Saturn, helping ideas become organised, communication become clearer and decisions gain practical structure. Something imagined around the New Moon can now be broken into stages, dates or responsibilities. The future may feel more believable once you can see how the first few pieces fit together.

Mercury is still separating from its square with Mars, so impatience may remain beneath the day’s more focused atmosphere. You may know what needs doing and feel frustrated when progress depends upon another person, a delayed reply or a process you cannot accelerate. Use that energy to prepare your own contribution thoroughly rather than pushing for movement before everything is ready.

Venus in Scorpio forms an exact sextile with Mars in Virgo, blending desire with practical effort. Creativity, relationships and shared projects can benefit when people demonstrate their interest through meaningful participation. Small acts of care may say more than dramatic promises, while a creative idea could become more satisfying once you begin shaping it with your hands.

Venus also remains close to its square with Pluto, adding depth and emotional intensity. You may feel strongly drawn towards a person, idea or outcome, although today offers a chance to channel that focus constructively. Notice whether your attention is helping something grow or keeping you emotionally tied to uncertainty.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
Structure may feel reassuring today, especially when recent feelings have been difficult to organise. Write down what you know, what you need and which part remains outside your control. Clear categories can prevent one uncertainty from colouring the entire situation.

Energy
Steady effort is more supportive than trying to complete everything in one determined burst. Choose a task that rewards concentration and give it an uninterrupted block of time. Visible progress will help rebuild momentum.

Relationships
Affection is easier to recognise through actions, reliability and thoughtful effort. Consider what you can genuinely contribute to a connection without overextending yourself. If an emotional dynamic feels intense, return to the behaviour you can observe.

Work and Purpose
Create a simple framework around an idea that deserves development. Give it a starting point, one milestone and a realistic review date. The goal is to provide enough structure for progress while allowing the plan to evolve through experience.

Spiritual Growth
Discipline can become an act of devotion when it protects what matters to you. Choose one practice, study or creative pursuit you want to meet consistently. Let repetition deepen your relationship with it rather than measuring every session by visible results.

Collective Energy
There may be greater interest in practical solutions and credible plans. People are more likely to trust ideas that include clear responsibilities and realistic expectations. Thoughtful preparation can help hopeful visions gain wider support.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Use today to give one New Moon intention a workable shape. Write the first three steps, gather the materials or information involved and decide when you will review your progress. If another person is involved, clarify responsibilities before momentum carries everyone in different directions. Let enthusiasm add warmth to the process while structure keeps it moving. A dream begins feeling possible when it has somewhere practical to land.

2026-12.title: ✦ 12 December - KEY TRANSIT: Neptune Stations Direct in Aries at 22:17 UK Time
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Notice which vision has remained meaningful through recent uncertainty.
✓ Give inspiration a form that allows you to interact with it.
✓ Create from instinct before deciding whether the result is useful.
✓ Let your spiritual practice support confidence and personal agency.
✓ Pay attention to the dream that now feels ready for participation.

DON’T
✕ Expect every uncertainty to disappear when Neptune changes direction.
✕ Chase an ideal that continually requires you to abandon yourself.
✕ Treat intuition as permission to overlook practical information.
✕ Wait for complete confidence before taking a gentle first step.
✕ Compare the earliest stage of your vision with somebody else’s finished work.

Neptune stations direct in Aries late tonight after travelling retrograde since mid-July. This brings a gradual shift within dreams, intuition, creativity and spiritual direction. Something that has felt difficult to define may begin moving closer to conscious understanding, especially where you have been questioning which visions genuinely belong to you.

Neptune in Aries asks us to explore the relationship between inspiration and identity. A dream can feel powerful, although it still needs somebody willing to participate in bringing it forward. Recent months may have revealed where you were waiting for permission, idealising a future version of yourself or following a path that no longer reflected your own spirit. The direct station encourages a more personal relationship with possibility.

Mercury continues its trine with Saturn, helping intuitive insight find practical language and structure. A creative or spiritual idea may become easier to explain, organise or include within everyday life. Write down what is becoming clearer and give the vision one reliable container, such as a routine, page, practice or project.

Venus forms an exact sextile with Mars, creating a warm and productive flow between desire and action. Relationships, creativity and personal projects can benefit from thoughtful participation. You may feel more willing to show interest, make something beautiful or take a practical step towards what attracts you.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
A feeling you have struggled to name may begin revealing its deeper meaning. Let clarity develop gradually rather than expecting one perfect realisation. Emotional understanding may arrive through an image, memory or bodily response before it becomes a complete explanation.

Energy
The Capricorn Moon supports focused effort, while Neptune’s station may make energy feel more sensitive. Choose work that has both purpose and personal meaning. Gentle concentration will be more effective than trying to push through exhaustion.

Relationships
Notice the difference between the connection you imagine and the relationship you are actively experiencing. Give value to consistent actions, honest communication and the way you feel after spending time with somebody. Mutual effort can make emotional depth feel safer.

Work and Purpose
A dream may be ready to become a project, practice or experiment. Create a simple container for it without demanding an immediate outcome. Give it a name, a dedicated space or a first draft so it can begin existing outside your imagination.

Spiritual Growth
Neptune direct in Aries asks you to participate in your own spiritual life. Choose a practice that strengthens trust in your inner guidance while keeping you connected to your body and present reality. Your intuition becomes easier to hear when it is supported by grounded self-awareness.

Collective Energy
Collective dreams around identity, leadership and change may begin finding stronger expression. Inspiration can encourage brave action, although discernment remains essential. Visions that respect reality and personal responsibility will have greater potential to create meaningful change.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Use today to recognise which dream has stayed with you throughout Neptune’s retrograde. Give it one tangible expression by naming it, sketching it, discussing it with somebody trustworthy or creating the first part. Allow uncertainty to remain around the details while becoming clearer about why the vision matters. Neptune will move slowly, so today is less about forcing an outcome and more about becoming an active participant in something you previously held only within your imagination.

2026-12.title: ✦ 13 December - KEY TRANSIT: Jupiter Stations Retrograde in Leo at 00:56 UK Time
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Revisit a creative idea that still excites you.
✓ Notice where confidence has grown since late June.
✓ Reconnect with talents you have stopped using.
✓ Question whose approval you are trying to earn.
✓ Give meaningful goals more time to develop.

DON’T
✕ Assume slower progress means you chose incorrectly.
✕ Perform confidence while ignoring what you truly feel.
✕ Measure your success entirely through attention or praise.
✕ Expand a commitment simply because the opportunity looks impressive.
✕ Abandon something valuable because it needs refining.

Jupiter begins its retrograde journey through Leo today, opening a period of reflection around confidence, creativity, visibility, joy and the space you allow yourself to occupy. Since Jupiter entered Leo at the end of June, you may have felt encouraged to dream more boldly, share more of yourself or pursue opportunities that allow your personality and talents to shine. The months ahead help you understand which forms of growth feel genuinely fulfilling.

You may begin reconsidering what success means when nobody is watching. A goal that once seemed exciting could need greater personal meaning, while an idea that has remained quietly important may deserve renewed attention. Jupiter retrograde can reveal where you have been seeking external confirmation for something your heart already understands.

This is also an opportunity to reconnect with enjoyment. Responsibilities, expectations or the pressure to make every talent productive may have moved you away from the experiences that naturally restore your enthusiasm. Creativity can become exploratory again, allowing you to follow curiosity without needing an immediate result.

The Aquarius Moon encourages emotional objectivity and helps you view your recent growth from a wider perspective. Mercury’s supportive connection with Saturn adds practical thinking, making it easier to identify which ambitions need stronger foundations. Venus and Mars also work together, supporting meaningful action towards relationships, creative ideas and desires that still carry energy.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
Give yourself room to recognise where you feel proud, overlooked, uncertain or ready for more. These feelings can reveal how closely your confidence has become connected to recognition from other people.

Energy
Your energy may turn inward as Jupiter changes direction. Use the slower rhythm to review what you are building, recover enthusiasm and decide which ambitions still deserve your full participation.

Relationships
Notice where appreciation flows naturally and where you feel compelled to impress, perform or compete for attention. Connections become warmer when people can celebrate one another without making affection feel conditional.

Work and Purpose
Revisit the projects, opportunities and professional goals that have developed since late June. Refine the ideas with genuine potential and release the pressure to make every possibility larger before it is ready.

Spiritual Growth
Explore the difference between being visible and being witnessed. Visibility places you in view, while being witnessed allows your authentic self to be recognised. Consider which experience you are truly seeking.

Collective Energy
There may be greater reflection around leadership, recognition, creativity and the people given space to influence others. We are being encouraged to question whether admiration is supported by substance and whether success still feels meaningful from within.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Return to something that once made you feel creatively alive. Consider how you would approach it now with everything you have learned since late June, then identify which part could be revived, refined or enjoyed again.

2026-12.title: ✦ 14 December - Give the Bigger Idea Somewhere to Land
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Follow ideas that open a new possibility.
✓ Give an exciting plan a practical structure.
✓ Spend time with people who encourage original thinking.
✓ Be honest about what you can consistently offer.
✓ Leave room for plans to develop differently.

DON’T
✕ Promise more than your time or energy can support.
✕ Turn enthusiasm into unnecessary pressure.
✕ Force agreement when several perspectives could be useful.
✕ Ignore a practical concern because an idea feels exciting.
✕ Treat a changing plan as a failed plan.

Today carries an optimistic and forward-looking quality, with the Sun working harmoniously with Jupiter. Ideas can feel larger, possibilities may become easier to see and something that recently lost momentum could begin inspiring you again. This energy encourages hope, while Jupiter’s new retrograde journey asks you to explore the opportunity before rushing to make it bigger.

The Aquarius Moon supports original thought and helps you step back from personal concerns long enough to see a wider range of options. Conversations with friends, communities or people who approach life differently could introduce an idea you would not have reached alone. You may also recognise where you have outgrown an expectation that once influenced your choices.

Mercury’s connection with Saturn helps transform inspiration into something workable. This is useful energy for organising information, creating a timeline, defining a boundary or working out what an idea would require in practice. You do not need to complete the whole plan today, although giving it a clear shape can make the possibility feel much more accessible.

Relationships may require a small adjustment between desire and responsibility. Venus and Mars support warmth, attraction and shared effort, while Venus’s connection with Saturn asks for honesty about time, availability and expectations. Clear communication can protect the enjoyment within a connection without making it feel overly complicated.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
A little distance can help you understand what you are feeling without becoming absorbed by it. Give yourself space to observe the pattern before deciding what needs to happen next.

Energy
Enthusiasm may arrive in bursts, especially around new ideas and future possibilities. Capture the inspiration, then choose one part that can be developed steadily rather than trying to act on everything at once.

Relationships
Speak openly about what feels enjoyable and what needs adjusting. A practical conversation can create more freedom within a connection when both people understand what is realistic.

Work and Purpose
Use the day to connect a big idea with a useful framework. Outline the stages, identify the resources involved or decide what would need to happen first.

Spiritual Growth
Notice which possibilities help you feel more expansive and more fully yourself. Growth can begin with recognising that a different future is available before you know exactly how you will reach it.

Collective Energy
People may feel drawn towards community, collaboration and ideas that challenge familiar ways of doing things. Shared thinking can generate fresh solutions when individuality is welcomed within the group.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Choose one possibility that genuinely excites you and give it a simple container. A page of notes, a rough timeline or a clear first stage will help the inspiration remain available after today’s enthusiasm settles.

2026-12.title: ✦ 15 December - Follow What Feels Alive
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Leave breathing room around your plans.
✓ Pay attention to unexpected ideas and emotional shifts.
✓ Choose commitments that feel meaningful and manageable.
✓ Create something inspired by your current mood.
✓ Allow relationships to develop at a sustainable pace.

DON’T
✕ Make permanent decisions during a passing emotional wave.
✕ Agree to something simply to avoid disappointing somebody.
✕ Ignore your intuition when a plan needs adjusting.
✕ Expect everyone to understand what you need without being told.
✕ Fill every quiet moment with noise or activity.

The Pisces Moon brings a softer and more intuitive atmosphere today, encouraging you to notice the feelings, images and subtle impressions moving beneath the surface. Inspiration may arrive through music, dreams, conversation or an unexpected moment of recognition. Give these impressions somewhere to land before trying to decide exactly what they mean.

The Moon’s connection with Uranus can make emotions or plans change quickly. An interruption may reveal an option you had not considered, while a sudden reaction could highlight where you need more freedom. Staying flexible will help you respond creatively without allowing one moment to determine the direction of the whole day.

The Sun continues its supportive connection with Jupiter, keeping possibility and optimism available. Something may feel worth exploring again, especially when it brings greater meaning, enjoyment or room for self-expression. With Jupiter now retrograde, the most valuable expansion may come through rediscovering what already inspires you.

Venus and Saturn ask for a thoughtful adjustment within relationships, finances or commitments. You may need to balance emotional depth with what can realistically be sustained. Honest limits can help you protect the time, trust and energy required for something meaningful to grow.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
Allow feelings to move before trying to organise them. Music, movement, water or creative expression can help you understand what your emotions are communicating.

Energy
Your energy may be sensitive to environments and other people today. Choose surroundings that help you remain open and inspired without becoming overwhelmed.

Relationships
Be clear about your availability and expectations. A small adjustment to timing, responsibility or communication could make a connection feel more comfortable and sustainable.

Work and Purpose
Keep enough structure to remain focused while allowing space for intuition. An unexpected idea may improve a project when you give yourself permission to explore it.

Spiritual Growth
Notice the symbols, coincidences and recurring thoughts that capture your attention. Record them without forcing an interpretation, then return later to see what pattern has emerged.

Collective Energy
There may be a stronger desire for freedom alongside greater emotional sensitivity. Flexibility and compassion can help people navigate changes without creating unnecessary distance.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Follow one unexpected spark and explore it gently. Create, research or experiment for a short period without demanding a finished result, allowing curiosity to show you where the energy wants to move.

2026-12.title: ✦ 16 December - Let the Feeling Find the Right Words
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Pause before replying to emotionally charged messages.
✓ Ask for clarification when something sounds confusing.
✓ Give feelings time to become easier to explain.
✓ Use creativity to express what conversation cannot yet hold.
✓ Keep plans spacious enough to accommodate your energy.

DON’T
✕ Treat your first interpretation as the only explanation.
✕ Over-explain yourself while emotions are still moving.
✕ Agree to a plan that your body is resisting.
✕ Turn one awkward exchange into a larger story.
✕ Force an immediate answer from yourself or somebody else.

The Pisces Moon forms a challenging connection with Mercury today, creating a gap between what you feel and what you can easily explain. Conversations may become muddled when tone, timing or assumptions carry more weight than the words themselves. Allow extra room for clarification and resist the urge to fill every silence with an immediate response.

Your intuition may be strong, although emotional sensitivity can influence how you interpret information. If something feels significant, note the feeling and wait for further context before deciding what it means. Writing privately, speaking aloud to yourself or using a creative outlet may help you discover the message beneath the initial reaction.

The Sun’s supportive connection with Jupiter continues to bring optimism and a wider perspective. A conversation, idea or opportunity can remind you that more than one route remains available. Jupiter’s retrograde journey encourages you to recognise which possibilities still feel personally meaningful once the excitement or outside approval has been removed.

Venus and Mars bring warmth, desire and creative chemistry, while their connections with Saturn ask for thoughtful pacing. There is energy available for connection and progress, provided expectations remain realistic. Giving something time to develop can deepen its value without removing the excitement surrounding it.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
Name the feeling before trying to explain the full story. A simple word such as disappointed, hopeful, uncertain or overstimulated can help you understand what support you need.

Energy
Your motivation may move between dreamy and productive phases. Work with these shifts by pairing focused tasks with moments of quiet, music or gentle movement.

Relationships
Check that you have understood what was meant before reacting to what you heard. A calm follow-up question can prevent a sensitive moment from becoming an unnecessary misunderstanding.

Work and Purpose
Capture imaginative ideas today, then return to the details when your concentration feels steadier. Creative thinking is available, although instructions, dates and practical information may need checking twice.

Spiritual Growth
Observe the difference between intuition and interpretation. Intuition often arrives simply, while interpretation builds a story around it. Give the original impression time to remain clear.

Collective Energy
Communication may feel more emotional and less precise, making patience especially valuable. People can understand one another more easily when questions are welcomed and assumptions are held lightly.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Translate one difficult-to-explain feeling into a form that gives it room to breathe. Write it as a letter you do not send, choose an image that represents it or create something that expresses the emotion without requiring an immediate conclusion.

2026-12.title: ✦ 17 December - A Dream Asks for Your Participation
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Choose one intention that deserves continued effort.
✓ Adjust your approach when progress feels awkward.
✓ Protect time for imagination and practical action.
✓ Notice which challenges are strengthening your commitment.
✓ Celebrate movement that cannot yet be seen by others.

DON’T
✕ Try to advance every goal at the same time.
✕ Confuse temporary discomfort with a reason to stop.
✕ Wait for perfect confidence before taking part.
✕ Push through tiredness to prove your dedication.
✕ Expect inspiration to complete the practical work for you.

The First Quarter Moon arrives in Pisces, creating the first meaningful point of action within the lunar cycle that began with the Sagittarius New Moon. The intentions, adventures and possibilities considered around 9 December may now need participation. Something that began as a vision is asking you to decide how much energy you are willing to give it.

First Quarter Moons often bring productive tension. You may recognise a gap between the future you imagined and the choices required to reach it. This awareness can help you refine the intention, strengthen your commitment or change the way you approach it. Progress may begin through a small adjustment rather than a dramatic leap.

The Pisces Moon keeps intuition and imagination close, while its connection with Jupiter can encourage you to reach beyond your current capacity. Stay hopeful while remaining honest about your time and energy. A dream becomes easier to support when you understand what it requires from your everyday life.

Mars and Saturn also highlight the need to work intelligently with your available energy. If an approach feels exhausting or unnecessarily complicated, change the method. The Sun’s supportive connection with Jupiter continues to encourage confidence, reminding you that meaningful expansion can develop through patient participation.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
A feeling of restlessness may reveal where you want movement. Ask yourself whether the emotion is requesting action, reassurance, rest or a change of approach.

Energy
Work in focused periods and stop before your energy becomes depleted. Consistent participation will support the intention more effectively than one unsustainable burst of effort.

Relationships
Pay attention to whether shared plans contain enough room for both people’s needs. A gentle adjustment can improve the way time, effort or emotional responsibility is being shared.

Work and Purpose
Choose the part of a larger goal that would make the greatest difference if completed. Giving one important task your full attention can restore momentum across the entire project.

Spiritual Growth
Treat intuition as an invitation to participate. When an inner message continues returning, explore how it could be honoured through a real decision, practice or commitment.

Collective Energy
There may be tension between dreaming about a better future and accepting the work required to create it. Progress becomes possible when inspiration is supported by thoughtful, repeatable action.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Choose one intention set around the Sagittarius New Moon and identify what it needs from you now. Make the next step small enough to begin today and meaningful enough to move the vision forward.

2026-12.title: ✦ 18 December - Let Confidence Become Commitment
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Back yourself in one meaningful decision.
✓ Channel enthusiasm into focused action.
✓ Choose progress you can continue tomorrow.
✓ Take responsibility for what you want to create.
✓ Let experience show you what needs adjusting.

DON’T
✕ Turn motivation into a punishing workload.
✕ Rush because you feel temporarily confident.
✕ Make promises based on your highest-energy moment.
✕ Take a delay as a personal rejection.
✕ Wait for somebody else to confirm that you are ready.

The Sun forms a harmonious connection with Jupiter today, bringing confidence, hope and a stronger sense of possibility. You may feel more willing to believe in yourself, share an idea or take a chance on something that has been quietly calling you forward. Jupiter’s retrograde motion makes this energy especially useful for returning to a goal you already care about with greater self-belief.

The Aries Moon adds courage and momentum, encouraging direct action. An idea may feel ready to leave the planning stage, or you may recognise that a decision has already been made internally. Taking one clear step can create the sense of movement you have been waiting for.

The Moon’s connection with Saturn asks you to take your enthusiasm seriously. Confidence becomes more valuable when it is supported by preparation, consistency and realistic expectations. You may need to accept one responsibility that comes with the opportunity you want, especially if it helps the next stage feel more secure.

Mars and Saturn continue to require an adjustment between effort and endurance. If progress feels slower than expected, consider whether the method is asking too much of you. A sustainable approach will allow ambition to remain energising instead of turning it into another source of pressure.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
Confidence may feel stronger today, although a moment of hesitation could appear once action becomes real. Let the nerves exist alongside your excitement and continue at a manageable pace.

Energy
Use the day’s momentum for something that benefits from courage, initiative or physical movement. Decide what completion looks like before you begin so enthusiasm does not become overextension.

Relationships
Be open about what you want while remaining aware of the other person’s pace and capacity. Directness can create greater understanding when it is paired with consideration.

Work and Purpose
Take ownership of an opportunity, decision or project that deserves your leadership. Begin the task that proves to you that you are ready to participate more fully.

Spiritual Growth
Notice where life is asking you to trust the person you have already become. Past experience may provide more evidence of your readiness than your current doubts allow you to recognise.

Collective Energy
There may be greater confidence around starting, leading and making independent choices. The strongest progress will come from combining personal courage with responsibility for the impact of those choices.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Choose one decision you have been circling and support it with a committed action. Send the message, make the request, begin the application or claim the space that allows the next chapter to move closer.

2026-12.title: ✦ 19 December - Follow the Idea That Expands You
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Share an idea that deserves more room.
✓ Follow your curiosity beyond familiar subjects.
✓ Speak with confidence about what excites you.
✓ Make space for learning, discovery and inspiration.
✓ Adjust your schedule before adding another commitment.

DON’T
✕ Assume every exciting idea needs immediate action.
✕ Dismiss a possibility because it feels ambitious.
✕ Speak so quickly that important details are missed.
✕ Pack more into the day than your energy can hold.
✕ Let practical delays reduce your belief in the vision.

Fire energy flows freely today, bringing enthusiasm, confidence and the desire to move towards something larger. The Sun and Moon work harmoniously together, helping your emotional needs and conscious direction feel more aligned. Decisions may become easier when you focus on what creates energy rather than what simply looks sensible from the outside.

The Sun’s connection with Jupiter remains strong, encouraging hope, self-belief and a broader view of what may be possible. A subject, opportunity or future plan could remind you how much you enjoy learning and growing. Jupiter’s retrograde motion may also reconnect you with an ambition that still has more to teach you.

The Aries Moon supports Mercury and Jupiter, creating an expressive and curious atmosphere. Conversations can open doors, generate ideas or help you see a situation from a more adventurous perspective. Follow the exchange that leaves you feeling inspired, while remembering to check any details that become lost within the excitement.

Mars and Saturn continue to highlight the relationship between effort and capacity. You may know exactly what you want to do while recognising that the current approach needs adjusting. Changing the pace, order or method can help you protect the momentum without making the plan smaller.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
Notice which conversations, environments and ideas make you feel more energised. Your emotional response can help you identify where genuine enthusiasm still exists.

Energy
Momentum may build quickly, especially once an idea captures your attention. Give yourself a clear focus so the day’s energy creates progress rather than several unfinished beginnings.

Relationships
Share plans, stories and possibilities with people who welcome your enthusiasm. An uplifting conversation can strengthen connection and inspire both people to think more boldly.

Work and Purpose
Explore the wider potential of something you are already developing. Research a new direction, consider a larger audience or identify where your knowledge could be used more creatively.

Spiritual Growth
Follow the subject that makes you want to know more. Curiosity can become a spiritual compass when it repeatedly leads you towards greater meaning and self-understanding.

Collective Energy
There may be a stronger desire for progress, freedom and inspiring ideas. People could feel more willing to speak openly about what they want next, creating opportunities for shared encouragement and collaboration.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Choose one idea that makes your world feel larger and spend time expanding your understanding of it. Read, research, ask questions or begin a conversation that introduces you to the next layer.

2026-12.title: ✦ 20 December - Build Something You Can Feel
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Focus on practical, visible progress.
✓ Let your body set the pace of the day.
✓ Finish one useful task before beginning another.
✓ Choose quality over speed.
✓ Create comfort that supports your concentration.

DON’T
✕ Push through physical signs that you need a pause.
✕ Make an emotional purchase for temporary reassurance.
✕ Force productivity when the method is not working.
✕ Let a slow start convince you that nothing is happening.
✕ Complicate a task that has a simple solution.

The Moon moves through Taurus today, bringing attention back to the body, the senses and the parts of life that create stability. After several days of fast-moving inspiration, you may feel ready to slow the pace and make something tangible from the ideas you have been exploring. Progress can feel especially satisfying when you can see, touch or measure what has changed.

The Moon’s supportive connection with Mars helps practical action flow more naturally. This is useful energy for organising a space, completing a physical task, preparing materials or working steadily on something that requires patience. The aim is to create momentum through grounded participation rather than urgency.

Mars and Saturn make another precise adjustment, revealing where effort and structure are working against one another. A task may need a different order, better tools or more realistic timing. Pay attention to physical tension and frustration, as both can show you where the process needs improving.

The Sun remains connected with Jupiter while moving closer to Neptune, blending optimism with imagination. A future possibility may feel especially appealing, although some details could still be unclear. Let the dream remain inspiring while you strengthen the practical foundation beneath it.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
Comfort can help your feelings settle into something easier to understand. Eat well, soften your surroundings and give yourself enough time to recognise what your body is communicating.

Energy
Choose a steady rhythm and stay with one task long enough to experience visible progress. Short pauses for water, food or movement can help you maintain your energy throughout the day.

Relationships
Affection may be expressed through presence, reliability and thoughtful gestures. Notice which forms of care help you feel secure and communicate those preferences clearly.

Work and Purpose
Complete something practical that supports a wider goal. Updating materials, preparing resources or improving your workspace can make future progress feel much easier.

Spiritual Growth
Bring a spiritual intention into the physical world through a simple act. Arrange a meaningful object, prepare a nourishing meal or spend time in nature with your attention fully present.

Collective Energy
There may be a stronger need for stability, comfort and tangible reassurance. Practical support and calm consistency can help people feel more secure while larger changes continue unfolding.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Choose one area that feels unfinished or unsettled and improve it using what you already have. Create order, comfort or visible progress that makes the next few days easier to move through.

2026-12.title: ✦ 21 December - KEY TRANSIT: The Sun Enters Capricorn at 20:50 UK Time
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Decide what deserves long-term commitment.
✓ Give an important goal a stronger foundation.
✓ Recognise how much you have already built.
✓ Create realistic standards for your time and energy.
✓ Honour the winter solstice with a moment of reflection.

DON’T
✕ Measure your progress only by what remains unfinished.
✕ Turn ambition into constant pressure.
✕ Carry responsibilities that no longer belong to you.
✕ Expect a long-term goal to produce instant results.
✕ Make your worth dependent on productivity.

The Sun enters Capricorn this evening, beginning a season centred around commitment, maturity, structure and the ambitions we are prepared to support over time. Capricorn energy encourages us to consider what we are building, why it matters and which foundations will help it last. The coming weeks can bring greater focus to responsibilities, goals, leadership and the practical choices shaping the future.

This ingress also marks the winter solstice in the Northern Hemisphere, bringing the longest night and the gradual return of light. It is a meaningful threshold for recognising what has carried you through the darker part of the year and deciding what you want to strengthen as the light begins to return. You may feel called to honour progress that happened quietly and name the direction you want to continue growing towards.

The Taurus Moon complements the earthy tone of Capricorn season, helping you connect future plans with your physical needs and personal values. The most worthwhile goal may be the one that creates greater stability, satisfaction or freedom within your everyday life. Let your body and available resources become part of the planning process.

Mars makes an exact adjustment with Saturn today, revealing where effort needs better structure. You may recognise that a task, schedule or responsibility cannot continue in its current form. Refining the method can help you preserve your ambition while creating a pace that remains sustainable.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
A calmer environment can help you understand what you genuinely want to commit to. Give yourself time to distinguish meaningful responsibility from pressure you have absorbed from elsewhere.

Energy
Direct your energy towards one priority with long-term value. Consistency will carry the goal further than trying to complete an entire chapter in one day.

Relationships
Consider which connections feel dependable, reciprocal and able to grow through real life. Reliability, clear expectations and respect for one another’s time can deepen trust.

Work and Purpose
Review the foundations beneath a major goal. Look at the skills, systems, time and support it requires, then decide which area needs strengthening first.

Spiritual Growth
Use the solstice as a quiet threshold. Reflect on the inner strength developed through this year and choose one quality you want to carry into the returning light.

Collective Energy
Attention begins shifting towards leadership, responsibility and the systems shaping our shared future. There may be greater awareness of which structures remain useful and which need to evolve.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Choose one long-term intention and create a physical symbol of commitment to it. Place a stone, candle, key or written word somewhere meaningful, allowing it to represent the foundation you are ready to build from.

2026-12.title: ✦ 22 December - Give Your Thoughts Somewhere to Go
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Write down ideas before they disappear.
✓ Ask questions when information feels incomplete.
✓ Give important decisions another round of thought.
✓ Choose conversations that expand your perspective.
✓ Build pauses into a mentally busy day.

DON’T
✕ Treat every passing thought as an instruction.
✕ Make promises while details remain unclear.
✕ Absorb somebody else’s certainty as your own.
✕ Rush to correct every misunderstanding immediately.
✕ Keep consuming information after your mind feels full.

The Gemini Moon brings curiosity, movement and a stronger appetite for conversation today. Your mind may jump quickly between subjects, ideas and possibilities, making this a useful day for gathering information and exploring different perspectives. Capture what interests you without expecting every thought to become a finished plan.

Mercury’s supportive connection with Jupiter encourages broader thinking. A conversation, article or question could introduce a more hopeful interpretation of something you have been considering. You may also feel ready to speak about a larger vision, especially when sharing it helps you understand the idea more clearly.

The Sun’s connection with Neptune can make the atmosphere feel imaginative and slightly blurred. Inspiration may be strong while practical certainty takes longer to arrive. Check details before making commitments and give yourself permission to keep exploring when the full picture has not yet formed.

Mars and Saturn remain closely connected, asking you to work with your actual capacity. Mental energy may move faster than physical energy, so avoid creating a schedule based on every idea that appears. A thoughtful filter will help you preserve the possibilities that genuinely deserve development.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
Talking can help you understand what you feel, although too many opinions may create additional confusion. Choose one trusted person or private outlet that allows your own voice to remain clear.

Energy
Alternate mentally demanding tasks with simple physical activity. A walk, stretch or practical job can help your thoughts settle before you return to the next decision.

Relationships
Curiosity can create more understanding than assumption. Ask open questions and allow conversations to reveal information gradually rather than trying to predict the other person’s answer.

Work and Purpose
Gather ideas, compare options and identify missing information. Keep notes organised so promising thoughts remain easy to revisit when you are ready to develop them.

Spiritual Growth
Notice which words, questions or ideas continue returning throughout the day. Repetition may reveal a theme worth exploring, even when its meaning is still unfolding.

Collective Energy
There may be more information, discussion and speculation moving through the collective. Thoughtful questions and careful listening can help people respond with greater awareness.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Create one place for every idea, question and loose thought that appears today. At the end of the day, return to the list and circle the one subject that still carries energy after the mental noise has settled.

2026-12.title: ✦ 23 December - Let Inspiration Breathe Before You Define It
2026-12.guidance:
**full moon is early hours of tomorrow, so if you want to work with it tonight, look at tomorrows cosmic current for what to do- rituals, tarot spread etc
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Leave space for imagination and daydreaming.
✓ Check important details before confirming plans.
✓ Notice where hope is returning.
✓ Ask for clarification when messages feel vague.
✓ Give creative ideas time to develop.

DON’T
✕ Build a firm conclusion from incomplete information.
✕ Assume you know what somebody else is thinking.
✕ Commit to a plan because it sounds inspiring in the moment.
✕ Ignore tiredness or emotional sensitivity.
✕ Demand certainty from an idea that is still forming.

The Sun forms an exact square with Neptune today, creating a dreamy, sensitive and imaginative atmosphere. Boundaries may feel softer, time can become easier to lose and your attention may drift towards memories, fantasies or future possibilities. Give yourself space to imagine while allowing practical decisions to wait for clearer information.

This energy can heighten compassion and creativity, making it easier to connect with music, art, symbolism and subtle emotional currents. You may sense that something is changing before you can explain it. Record the impression and allow its meaning to emerge gradually rather than trying to define it immediately.

Mercury’s harmonious connection with Jupiter brings a more hopeful and expansive quality to your thinking. A conversation or idea could help you see beyond a current limitation and remember that more possibilities exist. Check the practical details, especially when enthusiasm encourages you to overlook timing or logistics.

The Gemini Moon opposes Mercury, creating a difference between what the mind wants to say and what the emotions are ready to express. Pausing before responding can help you find language that represents the full experience. Mars and Saturn also continue to encourage realistic pacing, particularly when your energy feels more sensitive than usual.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
Allow feelings to remain unfinished for a while. You may understand more once the emotional atmosphere has settled and the pressure to explain yourself has eased.

Energy
Protect your concentration by reducing unnecessary stimulation. Choose a smaller number of priorities and include quiet moments between them.

Relationships
Listen for the feeling underneath the words while checking that you have understood the actual message. Gentle clarification can prevent imagined meanings from shaping the connection.

Work and Purpose
Use the day for creative development, brainstorming and exploring the wider vision. Review facts, instructions and commitments again before finalising anything important.

Spiritual Growth
Dreams, symbols and intuitive impressions may feel especially vivid. Record what appears and look for themes over time rather than expecting one immediate interpretation.

Collective Energy
People may feel more emotionally open, idealistic or uncertain. Clear language and compassionate boundaries can help everyone move through the softer atmosphere with greater awareness.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Give one vision a private place to develop. Create a mood board, collect images, choose music or gather words that capture how you want the idea to feel before deciding what form it should take.

2026-12.title: 24 May - Emotional Flow & Creative Connection
2026-12.guidance:
✦ 24 December - KEY TRANSIT: Full Moon in Cancer at 01:27 UK Time

✦ Dos and Don’ts

DO
✓ Honour emotions that have been building quietly.
✓ Notice what helps you feel safe, supported and at home.
✓ Acknowledge changes within family or belonging.
✓ Create space for rest and emotional release.
✓ Let care include your own needs.

DON’T
✕ Take responsibility for everybody’s feelings.
✕ Dismiss sensitivity as an inconvenience.
✕ Make decisions while emotionally overwhelmed.
✕ Continue nurturing something that repeatedly depletes you.
✕ Confuse familiarity with genuine security.

The Full Moon in Cancer illuminates home, family, belonging, emotional security and the ways we care for ourselves and others. Cancer is ruled by the Moon, making this lunation especially sensitive and instinctive. Feelings that have been gathering beneath the surface may become easier to recognise, bringing clarity around what helps you feel held and where greater emotional safety is needed.

Cancer is a cardinal water sign. Water connects us with emotion, intuition, memory and healing, while the cardinal modality encourages movement and new direction. This Full Moon can help you release an emotional pattern while actively creating a healthier form of care, connection or belonging.

The Cancer Moon opposes the Capricorn Sun, highlighting the relationship between private needs and external responsibilities. You may become aware of where achievement, duty or reliability has left too little room for rest, softness or emotional honesty. A more supportive balance can be created when your inner life is treated as part of the foundation beneath everything you build.

Neptune adds a dreamy and emotionally porous quality to the lunation. Memories, intuition and compassion may feel heightened, although boundaries and facts can become less distinct. Mercury’s supportive connection with Jupiter offers perspective, helping you speak about the bigger meaning of what you are feeling once the initial emotional wave has settled.

✦ The Cancer Lunar Timeline

Look back to the Cancer New Moon on 14 July 2026. Consider what was beginning around home, family, belonging, emotional security, support or your relationship with vulnerability. That New Moon occurred at 10:43 UK time, and this Full Moon may reveal what has grown, changed or reached an emotional culmination since then. 

The immediate release and integration period continues through the following two weeks. A longer Cancer cycle begins again with the Cancer New Moon on 4 July 2027 at 04:02 UK time, when the understanding gained now can support a new emotional beginning. 

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
Allow feelings to exist before deciding what action they require. An emotion may be asking for expression, reassurance, rest, protection or a change within your environment.

Energy
Sensitivity may be heightened, so choose a gentler rhythm where possible. Nourishing food, water, warmth and time in a familiar space can help your system settle.

Relationships
Notice where care flows mutually and where you automatically become responsible for maintaining everybody else’s comfort. Honest needs and compassionate boundaries can strengthen emotional trust.

Work and Purpose
Consider whether your responsibilities leave enough room for a life that feels emotionally fulfilling. A sustainable definition of success should include safety, connection and somewhere you can truly exhale.

Spiritual Growth
Explore your understanding of home as an inner experience. Ask which practices, people and environments help you return to yourself when the outside world feels demanding.

Collective Energy
Themes surrounding home, family, care and emotional security may become more visible. There may be a stronger awareness of the support people need behind the roles they perform publicly.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Recognise one emotional need that has become impossible to keep minimising. Give it a practical form through a boundary, conversation, environmental change or act of care that helps you feel safer and better supported.

✦ Cancer Full Moon Ritual: The Waters of Belonging

You will need:
- A bowl of water
- A pinch of salt
- Four small pieces of paper
- A pen
- An object that represents home, safety or belonging
- A towel
Place the bowl in front of you and add the salt. Set your chosen object beside it. Cancer’s water element is represented by the bowl, while its cardinal modality is honoured through the four choices you are preparing to make.

On the four pieces of paper, complete these sentences:
1. I am ready to protect…
2. I am ready to nourish…
3. I am ready to release…
4. I am ready to begin…
Let your answers relate to emotional security, home, family, care, belonging or the boundaries that help you remain connected to yourself.

Read each statement aloud. After every statement, place your fingertips in the water and pause long enough to feel what changes within your body.

Tear up the release statement and discard it. Place the remaining three beneath the object representing home. Keep them there until the Capricorn New Moon on 7 January 2027, allowing your choices to guide the way you care for yourself during the waning lunar cycle.

Finish by touching a little water to your wrists and heart while saying:

“I honour what I feel. I release what no longer feels safe to carry, and I create belonging through the care I choose now.”

Pour the salted water down the sink once the ritual is complete.

✦ Cancer Full Moon Tarot Spread: Returning Home

Card One: What emotion is asking to be fully acknowledged?

Card Two: What has reached fulfilment or clarity since the Cancer New Moon in July?

Card Three: Which emotional pattern am I ready to release?

Card Four: What boundary will protect my peace and emotional energy?

Card Five: What new form of care or belonging am I ready to create?

2026-12.title: ✦ 25 December 2026 - KEY TRANSIT: Mercury enters Capricorn at 18:23 UK
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Let conversations be sincere, simple and grounded
✓ Give your full attention to the people in front of you
✓ Turn a hopeful idea into one realistic next step
✓ Check facts before making promises or firm plans
✓ Leave space for feelings that cannot be neatly explained  

DON’T
✕ Turn every conversation into a planning meeting
✕ Make commitments simply to keep somebody happy
✕ Assume a strong feeling automatically reveals the full truth
✕ Force yourself to perform cheerfulness or sociability
✕ Correct, organise or advise when someone only wants to be heard  

Christmas Day carries the emotional afterglow of yesterday’s Cancer Full Moon, with the Moon still moving through Cancer. Home, belonging, memory and family dynamics remain close to the surface. A Moon–Venus trine adds warmth and tenderness, supporting meaningful traditions, affectionate exchanges and small gestures that make people feel genuinely considered.

Mercury spends most of the day at the final degree of Sagittarius before entering Capricorn this evening. During the day, thoughts may move quickly towards stories, possibilities and future plans. Mercury’s trine to Jupiter brings optimism and generous conversation, but its square to Neptune can blur details or encourage assumptions. Enjoy the storytelling, but treat dramatic declarations and half-heard information with care.

When Mercury enters Capricorn, the collective mind begins to settle. Ideas want structure, conversations become more purposeful and vague intentions start asking for dates, boundaries and practical steps. This is useful energy for considering what you want to build next, although there is no need to create an entire strategy over the Christmas pudding.

Mars remains closely quincunx Saturn, revealing the tension between what you want to do and what circumstances currently allow. If your energy fluctuates, adjust the pace instead of judging yourself. The most meaningful form of maturity today may be knowing when to help, when to rest and when to let something remain unfinished.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
Let comfort be uncomplicated. Familiar food, a favourite film, quiet company or a few minutes alone can give your nervous system exactly what it needs.

Energy
Work with the energy available rather than the energy you expected to have. Take breaks before exhaustion decides for you.

Relationships
Listen for what sits beneath the words. Someone may need reassurance, inclusion or understanding more than advice.

Work and Purpose
Capture useful ideas without turning the day into a productivity exercise. One clear note for later is enough.

Spiritual Growth
Notice which traditions still feel meaningful and which ones you have outgrown. Belonging becomes stronger when it has room to evolve.

Collective Energy
The mood is sentimental, generous and occasionally confusing. Keep expectations flexible and allow people to experience the day differently.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Be fully present with what matters today, then use Mercury’s evening move into Capricorn to name one grounded intention for the days ahead.

2026-12.title: ✦ 26 December 2026 - Give Your Joy Somewhere to Go
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Make room for something playful, creative or uplifting
✓ Give genuine praise when you notice something special in someone
✓ Bring gentle structure to an idea you want to develop
✓ Check the details before believing or repeating information
✓ Protect your energy if a situation becomes emotionally intense  

DON’T
✕ Perform happiness when you need a quieter moment
✕ Treat every passing thought as a sign or certainty
✕ Keep pushing when your body is asking for a slower pace
✕ Compete for attention or take somebody’s mood personally
✕ Make an important decision from pride, pressure or confusion  

The Moon moves into Leo today, shifting the emotional atmosphere towards warmth, expression and play. After the deeply sensitive Cancer Full Moon, this can feel like an invitation to lift your head, reconnect with joy and remember what makes you feel alive. There may be a stronger desire to be seen or appreciated, but the sweetest moments are likely to come through shared laughter, creative expression and generous encouragement.

Mercury is now settling into Capricorn, helping you organise your thoughts and speak with greater intention. Its trine to Jupiter supports bigger ideas, confident conversations and encouraging plans. There is potential to see what an idea could become, especially when you are willing to give it a realistic framework.

However, Mercury squares Neptune closely today, so clarity may come and go. Messages can be misunderstood, memories may become embellished and assumptions could quietly fill in missing information. If something feels confusing, give it time. You do not need to solve every mystery or respond immediately.

The Moon’s trine to Saturn can provide emotional steadiness, while its opposition to Pluto may bring deeper feelings, power dynamics or an unexpected sensitivity around recognition. Notice if you are seeking approval from someone who cannot currently offer it. Your joy does not need to be validated before you are allowed to enjoy it.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
Let yourself want warmth, attention and enjoyment without judging those needs. Choose people and places where you can relax into being yourself.

Energy
Your energy may arrive in bright bursts rather than one consistent flow. Use the lively moments for creativity, then give yourself permission to retreat and recharge.

Relationships
Offer sincere appreciation without expecting an immediate response. If tension rises, resist turning the moment into a contest over who is right or who cares more.

Work and Purpose
Give one exciting idea a basic structure. Capture the purpose, the first step and the support it would require, then leave the finer details until your thinking feels clearer.

Spiritual Growth
Explore the difference between being witnessed and seeking validation. The parts of you that feel most alive deserve expression even when nobody is applauding.

Collective Energy
People may be expressive, dramatic or more sensitive to being overlooked. A little generosity can soften the atmosphere, while patience will help prevent misunderstandings from growing.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Reconnect with something that makes you feel bright and expressive, then give that spark a simple container so it has somewhere to grow.

2026-12.title: ✦ 27 December 2026 - Share the Spark, Keep Your Feet on the Ground
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Share something you have recently learnt or realised
✓ Celebrate progress without exaggerating what comes next
✓ Let creativity guide you towards a fresh possibility
✓ Give yourself time to check plans, messages and information
✓ Notice where you are ready to outgrow the need for approval  

DON’T
✕ Make promises while caught up in the excitement of an idea
✕ Assume silence means rejection or disinterest
✕ Spend energy trying to impress somebody
✕ Force clarity when your thoughts are still rearranging themselves
✕ Ignore practical limits because enthusiasm feels more appealing  

The Leo Moon meets Jupiter today, turning up the warmth, generosity and desire for self-expression. Confidence can feel easier to access, and the disseminating Moon encourages you to share something gained from the recent lunar cycle. This could be wisdom, encouragement, a creative idea or a story that helps someone see their own possibilities differently.

The Moon also opposes the North Node and squares Venus, which may reveal where the desire to be liked has been influencing your choices. Attention can feel especially meaningful today, yet there is a risk of measuring your worth through other people’s responses. Enjoy recognition when it arrives, but try not to chase it when it does not.

Mercury in Capricorn forms supportive connections with Mars and Jupiter, giving ideas momentum and helping you speak with confidence. This can be brilliant for shaping plans, explaining a vision or identifying a practical route towards something bigger. The Sun’s trine to Mars adds determination, so there is plenty of potential for purposeful action.

At the same time, Mercury is closely square Neptune and almost exactly quincunx Uranus. Thoughts may change suddenly, technology could behave unpredictably or a conversation may take an unexpected turn. The Sun’s square to Saturn adds pressure to be sensible or get everything right. Stay flexible, check the details and remember that a delayed answer can be wiser than an immediate one.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
Let yourself enjoy feeling proud, expressive and hopeful. If validation becomes unusually important, pause and offer yourself the recognition you are seeking elsewhere.

Energy
Enthusiasm may run ahead of your actual capacity. Choose one satisfying outlet for the extra fire and build recovery time around it.

Relationships
Generosity can create beautiful moments, although expectations may become inflated. Give freely where it feels genuine and avoid keeping an invisible score.

Work and Purpose
Share an idea, lesson or piece of work that could help others. Review every important detail before presenting it as final.

Spiritual Growth
Notice where your path is asking you to step beyond performance. Your purpose becomes clearer when expression comes from truth rather than the need to impress.

Collective Energy
The mood is bold, creative and excitable, but information may be unreliable or incomplete. Stay curious without treating every sudden revelation as a final answer.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Share what you have discovered, celebrate how far you have come and leave enough space for the next part of the story to reveal itself.

2026-12.title: ✦ 28 December 2026 - Clear the Clutter, Keep the Magic
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Choose one useful task and give it your full attention
✓ Simplify a routine that has become unnecessarily complicated
✓ Move your body to release restless or frustrated energy
✓ Turn a recent realisation into a practical adjustment
✓ Aim for steady progress rather than a flawless result  

DON’T
✕ Fill the entire day with jobs simply because you feel motivated
✕ Criticise yourself or others over small mistakes
✕ Make sudden changes without considering the consequences
✕ Treat rest as something you must earn
✕ Let one delay convince you that the whole plan is failing  

The Moon moves into Virgo and forms an almost exact trine with the Capricorn Sun, creating a beautifully productive flow between how you feel and what you want to accomplish. After two expressive Leo Moon days, attention turns towards organisation, wellbeing and the small details that help life run more smoothly.

The Moon also meets Mars in Virgo, which can create a strong urge to get moving, fix problems and clear away anything that feels inefficient. This is excellent energy for tackling a specific task or refreshing a routine, but it can become irritable if you expect everything to happen immediately. Give the energy a focused outlet and stop before useful effort turns into frustrated overworking.

A trine between the Moon and Mercury supports clear thinking, constructive conversations and practical decision-making. You may find it easier to explain what you need, organise your thoughts or identify the missing detail within a plan. Mercury’s trine to Mars adds momentum, helping you move from discussion into action.

The Sun’s square to Saturn remains strong, so responsibilities or limitations may still feel heavier than usual. Mercury also squares Saturn and Neptune, which can bring moments of doubt, muddled thinking or harsh self-judgement. You do not need to have every answer today. Work with what is clear, leave room for revisions and allow a simple improvement to count as meaningful progress.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
You may feel calmer when your surroundings and plans have some order. Choose one area to organise rather than trying to correct everything at once.

Energy
Physical movement can help release mental tension. Keep it purposeful and manageable, especially if your body is asking for gentleness.

Relationships
Practical support may feel especially meaningful today. Ask what would genuinely help before stepping in to solve somebody else’s problem.

Work and Purpose
This is strong energy for editing, planning, organising and completing a focused task. Define what finished looks like before you begin.

Spiritual Growth
Notice where perfectionism has disguised itself as preparation. Your path can unfold through experiments, adjustments and imperfect first attempts.

Collective Energy
People may be helpful and productive, but more sensitive to mistakes or disruption. Patience and clear communication will prevent minor issues from becoming bigger than they need to be.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Choose one part of your life that could feel lighter, clearer or more supportive, then make one practical improvement you can genuinely maintain.

2026-12.title: ✦ 29 December 2026 - Make Space for What Truly Matters
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Be realistic about what can be completed today
✓ Choose quality over quantity in your plans and commitments
✓ Accept practical support when it is offered
✓ Make time for a calming or restorative pleasure
✓ Speak clearly about your limits before frustration builds  

DON’T
✕ Measure your progress against somebody else’s timeline
✕ Take on extra responsibility to prove your reliability
✕ Let one obstacle become a story about your abilities
✕ Overanalyse every detail until you lose momentum
✕ Agree to plans that leave you feeling depleted  

The Virgo Moon keeps the atmosphere practical and observant, encouraging you to notice what needs attention and what can be improved. This is useful energy for preparing, sorting and refining, but it may also make imperfections feel louder than they deserve. Keep your focus on what is genuinely helpful rather than searching for problems to solve.

The Sun forms a close square to Saturn today, which can highlight delays, duties or the reality of limited time and energy. You may become aware of where a plan needs stronger foundations, clearer boundaries or more patience. This energy can feel serious, but it offers an opportunity to make decisions that protect your future capacity.

A precise sextile between the Moon and Venus softens the day considerably. Comfort can be found through meaningful connection, a peaceful environment and small acts of care. Venus in Scorpio favours sincerity over surface-level pleasantries, so a quiet conversation with someone you trust may feel more nourishing than a crowded or demanding social plan.

Mercury’s trine to Mars helps you think practically and act on what you decide. It supports direct communication, efficient problem-solving and focused effort. However, Mercury remains square Saturn and Neptune, so avoid making firm conclusions when facts are missing. Give yourself permission to check, clarify and change your mind as new information arrives.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
A sense of responsibility may sit heavily today. Separate what genuinely belongs to you from what you have absorbed from other people’s expectations.

Energy
Use your energy in measured amounts. A short, focused effort followed by proper rest will be more supportive than pushing through fatigue.

Relationships
Choose honest, low-pressure connection. Let people know what you have capacity for rather than disappearing or agreeing to more than you want.

Work and Purpose
Review one goal through the lens of sustainability. Adjust the timeline, workload or support around it so that progress remains possible.

Spiritual Growth
Notice whether your inner voice is guiding you or grading you. Growth needs honesty, but it also needs patience and compassion.

Collective Energy
There may be a strong desire to organise, prepare or regain control. Keeping expectations realistic will help people work together without unnecessary pressure.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Protect your time, focus on what carries genuine value and create enough breathing room for the right priorities to receive your care.

2026-12.title: ✦ 30 December 2026 - Find the Balance Between Grace and Grit
2026-12.guidance:
✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Make decisions from your actual capacity
✓ Create calm before beginning an important conversation
✓ Take purposeful action on something within your control
✓ Allow plans to be adjusted without treating it as failure
✓ Choose honest harmony over keeping everyone pleased  

DON’T
✕ Say yes simply to avoid disappointing someone
✕ Make a final decision while feeling confused or pressured
✕ Assume you are responsible for everybody’s mood
✕ Use productivity to avoid an emotional truth
✕ Let one difficult moment define the entire day  

The Moon moves into Libra today, bringing relationships, fairness and balance into focus. There may be a stronger desire for peace, beauty and cooperation, but the Moon’s square to Mercury suggests that your feelings and words may not immediately agree. Take a little time to understand what you actually want before trying to explain it.

The Moon opposes both Saturn and Neptune, creating an emotional pull between reality and expectation. You may notice where you have idealised a person, plan or outcome, only to meet a practical limitation. This does not have to become a disappointment. It can help you understand which dreams need stronger boundaries and which responsibilities no longer feel fair.

The Sun and Mercury are both closely square Saturn, making commitments, consequences and long-term priorities difficult to ignore. Conversations may feel serious or progress may appear slower than you hoped. Be mindful of harsh self-talk. Saturn’s purpose here is to strengthen what matters, and that process becomes much easier when you stop demanding instant perfection.

There is also real momentum available. The Sun and Mercury trine Mars, helping you take practical action, communicate directly and deal with tasks that require courage or concentration. The Moon’s exact trine to Pluto adds emotional insight, making it easier to recognise a deeper pattern and choose a more empowering response.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
Give yourself time to separate your own feelings from the atmosphere around you. Calm does not require you to ignore what is uncomfortable.

Energy
Your motivation is strongest when it has a clear purpose. Choose one meaningful task and allow everything else to remain optional.

Relationships
Speak with kindness and precision. If you need space, reassurance or a change of plan, say so without wrapping the request in unnecessary explanation.

Work and Purpose
Use today to strengthen a plan through honest assessment. Decide what needs action, what needs support and what can be released.

Spiritual Growth
Look beneath the desire to keep the peace. A deeper form of balance becomes possible when your own needs are included in the equation.

Collective Energy
People may be navigating unspoken pressure while trying to appear composed. Clear expectations and thoughtful communication will create more ease than guessing what others need.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Bring one situation back into balance by combining honest communication, realistic expectations and a practical next step.

2026-12.title: 31 May - Full Moon in Sagittarius
2026-12.guidance:
✦ 31 December 2026 - Close the Year With Intention

✦ Dos and Don’ts

DO
✓ Acknowledge what you have accomplished this year
✓ Choose a few meaningful intentions instead of an overwhelming list
✓ Say what needs to be said with clarity and kindness
✓ Let your plans reflect your actual energy and desires
✓ Release expectations that no longer belong to you  

DON’T
✕ Judge the year only by what remains unfinished
✕ Set goals from pressure, comparison or panic
✕ Commit to plans simply because they sound impressive
✕ Force yourself to be social if you need a quieter evening
✕ Carry every disappointment into the new year as proof of failure  

The final day of 2026 arrives beneath a Third Quarter Moon in Libra, creating a natural moment of review, release and recalibration. This lunar phase invites you to recognise what has run its course and decide what deserves to travel forward with you. Libra asks that your next chapter includes greater balance, reciprocity and peace.

The Sun and Mercury meet closely in Capricorn, bringing a moment of mental clarity around your direction, priorities and longer-term plans.
