Ideas may feel more serious or significant today, and there can be a strong desire to name what you want from the year ahead. Keep your intentions grounded enough to support, rather than pressure, the person who will be living them.

Both the Sun and Mercury form powerful trines to Mars, giving you motivation to act on what you decide. You may feel ready to complete a task, make a firm choice or prepare something that gives the coming year a sense of momentum. This energy favours purposeful action, especially when the step is specific and achievable.

Mercury’s close square to Saturn can make the inner voice unusually critical, while Venus exactly squares the North Node, highlighting choices around relationships, values and self-worth. You may recognise where loyalty to an old dynamic has been influencing your future. Let the review be honest without becoming a trial. You are allowed to close the year with gratitude for how much you have learnt, including through the plans that changed.

✦ How to Work With It

Emotions
Make room for mixed feelings. Pride, relief, excitement and grief can all exist within the same ending.

Energy
Use the available momentum for one meaningful act of completion or preparation. Save enough energy to experience the evening in the way that feels right for you.

Relationships
Choose connection that feels mutual and genuine. You do not need to create harmony by abandoning your own preferences.

Work and Purpose
Identify the work, dream or responsibility you genuinely want to carry forward. Give it one clear starting point rather than an entire impossible plan.

Spiritual Growth
Release the belief that your worth must be proven through constant achievement. Let the next chapter begin with self-respect woven into its foundations.

Collective Energy
There may be pressure to make the evening memorable or declare a dramatic new beginning. Quiet reflection and sincere connection can be equally meaningful.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
Close the year by recognising what shaped you, releasing what has completed its purpose and choosing one intention that feels worthy of your energy in 2027.

2027-01.title: 1 May - Full Moon in Scorpio- Mercury conjunct Chiron (20:07 GMT)
2027-01.guidance:
✦ The Full Moon in Scorpio: Emotional Truth, Release, and Reclamation
This Full Moon opens the month with depth, honesty, and a level of emotional awareness that cannot be ignored. Scorpio energy moves beneath the surface, into the spaces where attachments, fears, and unspoken feelings have been quietly shaping your experience. What rises now is not random. It is what has been ready to be seen.
Scorpio governs intimacy, trust, power, and the energetic ties that bind you to people, patterns, and past experiences. Under this Full Moon, you may feel a heightened sensitivity to where your energy has been invested, especially in situations where something feels heavy, imbalanced, or no longer aligned with who you are becoming. There is a natural awareness of where you have been holding on beyond what feels supportive.
This is an energy of release, although it moves through awareness rather than force. Emotional clarity deepens when you allow yourself to sit with what is true, without trying to rush to a conclusion or push yourself into immediate change. What is ready to fall away will do so through recognition and acceptance.
There is also a strong sense of personal power available here. When you see something clearly, you begin to shift your relationship with it. This Full Moon invites you to reconnect with your own emotional authority, to honour what you feel, and to trust the quiet knowing that comes from within.

✦ Mercury Conjunct Chiron: Healing Through Thought, Voice, and Inner Narrative
With Mercury aligning with Chiron on the same day, there is a clear link between what you feel and how you understand it. Thoughts, memories, and conversations may naturally turn toward areas that have felt sensitive or unresolved, especially around communication, self-expression, and the stories you carry about yourself.
This energy brings awareness to the way you speak to yourself internally, as well as how you express your truth externally. Old narratives can rise gently into focus, not to pull you backwards, but to be seen with a new level of compassion and understanding. There is space here to soften the way you interpret past experiences and to recognise how much growth has already taken place.
Conversations can carry a healing quality when approached with openness and care. This is not about saying everything at once or forcing vulnerability, but about allowing honesty to exist without pressure. Even small shifts in language, both internally and externally, can begin to create meaningful change.
Together, these two influences create a day where emotional truth and mental awareness work hand in hand. What you feel and what you understand begin to align more clearly, creating space for deeper healing.

✦ The Energy of the Day: Release, Awareness, and Emotional Alignment
There is a natural invitation to slow down and move inward. This is not a day for pushing forward or trying to stay busy in order to avoid what is coming up. It is a day for listening, noticing, and allowing yourself to be present with your own experience.
You may feel more introspective, more aware of subtle emotional shifts, or more attuned to what feels aligned and what does not. This awareness is supportive. It helps you move forward with greater clarity, even if the full picture has not yet formed.
Let the day unfold at its own pace. There is no need to rush what is already in motion.

✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Allow yourself to feel what comes up without rushing to fix it
✓ Pay attention to patterns that are becoming more visible
✓ Speak to yourself with patience and understanding
✓ Create space for honest reflection
✓ Trust your emotional awareness

DON’T
𐄂 Ignore what is surfacing
𐄂 Push yourself to move on too quickly
𐄂 Overanalyse every feeling
𐄂 Default to old narratives without questioning them
𐄂 Force conversations before you feel ready

✦ How to Work With It
Emotions
Emotionally, this energy brings depth and sensitivity, with a strong awareness of what feels true beneath the surface. Feelings may come through with clarity, especially around attachment, trust, and personal boundaries. There is value in allowing emotions to be experienced fully without needing to immediately understand or resolve them. When you give yourself space to feel, insight follows naturally.

Energy
Energetically, this can feel intense at times, followed by moments of calm as things begin to settle. Emotional processing requires energy, so it is important to support your system through rest, nourishment, and grounding practices. Slowing your pace slightly allows the energy to move more smoothly through you.

Relationships
In relationships, there may be a stronger awareness of emotional dynamics and energetic exchange. You may notice where things feel balanced and where they do not. This awareness supports more honest and conscious connections, even if changes unfold gradually rather than all at once.

Work and Purpose
This is not a day that naturally supports pushing forward with external demands. Instead, it offers an opportunity to reflect on what feels aligned and sustainable. Insights that arise now can guide future decisions, especially around where your energy is best invested.

Spiritual Growth
Spiritually, this is a moment of deep inner alignment. Growth comes through honesty, self-awareness, and the willingness to sit with what is present. This is the kind of energy that strengthens your connection to your own intuition and inner guidance.

Collective Energy
Collectively, there is a focus on emotional truth, power dynamics, and deeper awareness around what has been hidden or overlooked. This is a time where underlying themes may come into clearer view, encouraging reflection and gradual transformation.

✦ Full Moon Ritual: The Rite of Emotional Release and Reclamation
This ritual is designed to support the release of emotional weight while reconnecting you to your own sense of inner power.

Preparation
Create a calm, comfortable space where you will not be disturbed.

You will need:
• One candle
• A bowl of water
• Pen and paper
• Optional grounding object such as a stone or crystal

☾ Step 1: Opening the Space
Light the candle and sit quietly for a few moments. Focus on your breath and allow your body to soften. Bring your awareness to what you are feeling without trying to change it.

☾ Step 2: Emotional Release
Write down what you are ready to release. This can be emotions, patterns, attachments, or ways of thinking that feel heavy. Be honest without filtering yourself.

☾ Step 3: Letting Go
Read what you have written slowly, acknowledging it fully. Tear the paper and place it into the bowl of water, allowing it to soften and dissolve. As you do this, imagine the emotional weight beginning to lift.

☾ Step 4: Reclaiming Your Energy
Place your hands over your heart or hold your grounding object. Focus on your breath and bring your awareness back to yourself. Feel your energy returning to you, steady and clear.

☾ Step 5: Integration
Sit quietly for a few minutes, allowing everything to settle. When you are ready, extinguish the candle with a sense of completion.

✦ Sacred Support Practices
• Journalling with honesty and without judgement
• Time alone to process and reflect
• Gentle grounding practices such as walking or sitting in nature
• Drinking water or herbal teas to support emotional release
• Crystals such as obsidian, smoky quartz, malachite, or moonstone

✦ Best Use of This Energy
The most aligned way to move through this Full Moon is by allowing emotional awareness to guide you. When you give yourself permission to see what is true, you create space for real change to begin. This is not about forcing transformation. It is about recognising what is ready to shift and trusting yourself to move with it.

2027-01.title: 2 May - Integration & Perspective
2027-01.guidance:

This keeps the energy from becoming scattered and instead supports a slower, more intentional integration of everything that has just moved through.

Jupiter in Gemini adds a layer of curiosity and mental openness, encouraging you to explore different perspectives without needing to land on one immediately.

✓ Spend time doing something that lifts your mood or energy
✓ Reflect on what you have learned rather than what you need to fix

This is a good day for reflection and light planning rather than pushing forward. Ideas can come through when you give yourself space to think without forcing outcomes.

Spiritually, this is about integration. What was revealed yesterday begins to settle into your awareness in a way that feels easier to understand.

Collective Energy
Collectively, there is a shift toward perspective and meaning. The intensity softens slightly, allowing for a broader understanding of recent emotional shifts.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
The most aligned way to move through today is by giving yourself space to breathe and allowing perspective to form naturally. Clarity comes more easily when you stop trying to force it.

2027-01.title: 3 May – KEY TRANSIT – Mercury enters Taurus Stabilising Thoughts & Clear Direction
2027-01.guidance:

There is less urgency to react and more space to reflect, which allows your thoughts to settle into something that feels clearer and more reliable.
This shift supports decision making that is rooted in what is actually sustainable for you. You may find yourself thinking more about long-term outcomes, what feels secure, and where your energy is best invested. There is a natural pull toward simplicity, consistency, and choices that feel aligned rather than rushed.
Clarity comes through steadiness today. When you allow yourself to slow down, you begin to recognise what truly matters and what is worth building over time.

With the Moon moving through Sagittarius, there is still a sense of openness and perspective running alongside this grounded shift. Emotionally, you are able to step back and see the bigger picture, while mentally you are beginning to anchor your thoughts into something more practical.
The Sun and Venus in Taurus strengthen this steady, stabilising energy, helping you reconnect with what feels calm, secure, and genuinely aligned. There is less interest in anything that feels chaotic or unnecessary, and more focus on what brings a sense of ease and reliability.
Mars in Cancer continues to guide your actions through emotional awareness, encouraging you to move in ways that feel safe and supportive. Jupiter in Gemini keeps curiosity present, allowing you to explore ideas without needing to commit immediately.
This creates a really supportive balance. You are able to think clearly, feel steadily, and move forward in a way that feels grounded and intentional.

✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Take your time with decisions and allow them to settle naturally
✓ Focus on what feels stable and sustainable
✓ Ground yourself before making choices
✓ Simplify anything that feels overcomplicated
✓ Trust the clarity that comes through calmness

DON’T
𐄂 Rush decisions just to feel like you are moving forward
𐄂 Overload yourself with too many options

✦ How to Work With It
Emotions
Emotionally, this is a day where steadiness becomes available in a way that feels supportive and reassuring. After the intensity of recent days, there is a natural settling that allows you to feel more anchored within yourself. You may notice that your emotional responses are less reactive and more considered, which helps you understand what you are feeling without becoming overwhelmed by it.
This is a supportive time to reconnect with what feels calm and genuinely aligned. If emotions arise, they tend to move more slowly, giving you the opportunity to sit with them and understand what they are showing you. There is value in allowing yourself to feel without rushing to interpret or resolve everything.

Energy
Energetically, this is a grounding and stabilising day. You may feel drawn to slow your pace slightly and move more intentionally, focusing on what feels sustainable rather than what feels urgent. There is a quiet productivity available when you work with this energy, especially when you allow yourself to complete things fully rather than rushing between tasks.
Your energy responds well to consistency today. Small, steady actions create a stronger sense of progress and help you build momentum in a way that feels manageable and supportive.

Relationships
In relationships, communication becomes more thoughtful and deliberate. You may find that you are more aware of what you want to say and how you want to say it, which creates space for more grounded and meaningful conversations. There is less pressure to react and more space to respond with intention.
This is a good day to approach conversations with patience, especially when expressing needs or setting expectations. Taking your time helps create a stronger sense of understanding and stability within your connections.

Work and Purpose
This is a really supportive day for practical progress. Your thinking is clearer, more structured, and more focused on what will actually work in the long term. This allows you to make decisions that feel reliable rather than reactive.
You may feel drawn to focus on quality rather than speed, which supports better outcomes overall. This is a good time to plan, organise, and begin building something in a way that feels steady and aligned.

Spiritual Growth
Spiritually, this energy supports grounding your awareness into your everyday life. Insight becomes more meaningful when it is applied consistently and realistically. You are not being asked to reach for something distant, you are being invited to embody what you already know.
There is something powerful about showing up for yourself in small, consistent ways. This is where deeper growth begins to take shape.

Collective Energy
Collectively, there is a shift toward stability and practical thinking. The pace slows slightly, allowing for more considered decisions and a stronger focus on long-term direction. There is less impulsiveness and more intention in how energy is being used, which supports more sustainable progress overall.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
The most aligned way to move through today is by slowing down and trusting the clarity that comes through steadiness. When you allow yourself to move at a pace that feels grounded and intentional, your next steps become much clearer and far more supportive.

2027-01.title: 4 May – Organisation & Reset
2027-01.guidance:
✦ The Energy of the Day: Grounding, Focus, and Practical Alignment
Today carries a noticeable shift in tone as the Moon moves from Sagittarius into Capricorn. The openness and perspective of the last couple of days begins to settle into something more focused, structured, and intentional. Emotionally, there is less desire to explore and more of a pull toward getting your life into order in a way that feels steady and manageable.
With the Sun, Mercury, and Venus all in Taurus, there is already a strong grounding influence present, and the Capricorn Moon strengthens this even further. This combination supports practical thinking, clear priorities, and a natural motivation to focus on what actually needs to be done.
There is something very productive about today’s energy, although it works best when approached calmly rather than with pressure. You may feel more aware of your responsibilities, your goals, and where your time and energy are being directed. This awareness is helpful, especially when it is used to create structure rather than stress.
Mars in Cancer continues to bring an emotional layer into your actions, which means you may be more mindful of what feels supportive and what does not. This can help you make choices that are not only practical, but also aligned with your emotional wellbeing.
Jupiter in Gemini keeps ideas moving in the background, allowing you to think about different approaches, while Saturn in Pisces reminds you to stay connected to what feels meaningful, not just what feels productive.
This is a day where small, consistent actions can create a strong sense of progress. There is no need to do everything at once. What matters is that you begin.

✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Focus on what feels manageable and realistic
✓ Organise your time, space, or priorities
✓ Take steady action toward your goals
✓ Create structure that supports you
✓ Work with the energy rather than rushing it

DON’T
𐄂 Overload yourself with too much at once
𐄂 Turn responsibility into pressure
𐄂 Ignore your emotional needs while being productive
𐄂 Compare your progress to others
𐄂 Expect everything to be perfect

✦ How to Work With It
Emotions
Emotionally, there is a more contained and steady feeling today. You may feel more focused on what needs to be handled rather than what needs to be explored, which can create a sense of stability.

Energy
Energetically, this is a supportive day for getting things done in a calm and structured way. You may feel more motivated when you have a clear plan or direction.

Relationships
In relationships, the energy is more practical than emotional. There may be a focus on responsibilities, shared goals, or simply supporting each other in everyday ways.

Work and Purpose
This is a strong day for productivity, organisation, and taking practical steps forward. Even small progress will feel satisfying.

Spiritual Growth
Spiritually, this is about grounding your awareness into your daily life. Growth comes through consistency and showing up for what matters.

Collective Energy
Collectively, there is a focus on responsibility, structure, and steady progress. The energy supports building something that can last.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
The most aligned way to move through today is by focusing on what is in front of you and taking steady, intentional action. Progress builds naturally when you keep things simple and consistent.

2027-01.title: 5 May - Steady Progress & Building Momentum
2027-01.guidance:

Today carries a grounded and steady energy that supports progress in a way that feels manageable and sustainable. With the Moon continuing its journey through Capricorn, there is a natural focus on responsibility, structure, and the steps needed to move things forward in a practical way.

Relationships

This is a strong day for building momentum through practical action. Progress may feel slow, but it is meaningful and long-lasting.

Collective Energy

2027-01.title: 6 May - KEY TRANSIT - Pluto Retrograde in Aquarius Inner Power & Deep Recalibration
2027-01.guidance:
✦ Pluto Retrograde in Aquarius: Inner Transformation and Power Awareness
Pluto turning retrograde marks a shift that is subtle on the surface yet deeply significant beneath it. This is not a fast or external change. This is an internal recalibration that begins to unfold over time, bringing your attention inward toward patterns, dynamics, and areas of your life that are ready to evolve.
In Aquarius, Pluto is working through themes of identity within the collective, your place in wider systems, your relationship to community, and the ways you express your individuality. As it turns retrograde, the focus shifts away from external transformation and into your internal relationship with these themes.
You may begin to notice where you have been giving your power away, where you have been conforming in ways that do not feel aligned, or where deeper shifts are already underway beneath the surface. This is not about sudden change. It is about awareness, and the quiet restructuring that begins when you see something clearly.
Pluto’s work is always about truth, depth, and transformation. When it stations retrograde, it invites you to engage with that work internally, in a way that is gradual, intentional, and deeply personal.

✦ The Energy of the Day: Grounded Awareness and Subtle Shifts
With the Moon in Capricorn and a strong Taurus influence still present, there is a grounded and steady container for this deeper work. You are not being pulled into emotional overwhelm. You are being supported in observing, understanding, and beginning to process what is shifting.
The Capricorn Moon brings emotional maturity and a sense of control, helping you approach deeper themes with clarity rather than intensity. At the same time, the Taurus placements continue to anchor you, reminding you to stay connected to your body, your environment, and what feels stable.
Mars in Cancer adds an emotional awareness to your actions, while Jupiter in Gemini keeps your mind open and curious. Saturn in Pisces continues to guide you toward aligning structure with meaning, helping you stay connected to what truly matters.
This creates a really supportive balance for this kind of internal work. You are able to reflect without becoming overwhelmed, and to notice what is shifting without needing to act on everything immediately.

✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Pay attention to what is coming into your awareness
✓ Reflect on where your power is being directed
✓ Allow insights to unfold gradually
✓ Stay grounded in your body and your environment
✓ Trust the process of internal change

DON’T
𐄂 Force transformation before you are ready
𐄂 Ignore deeper patterns that are becoming visible
𐄂 Try to control everything that is shifting
𐄂 Rush to make external changes immediately
𐄂 Disconnect from yourself while processing

✦ How to Work With It
Emotions
Emotionally, this energy can bring a quiet awareness of deeper patterns, especially those connected to control, trust, and personal power. You may notice subtle shifts in how you feel about certain situations, even if you cannot fully explain them yet. This is not about intense emotional release. It is about recognising what is there and allowing it to be seen without pressure.
There can be a sense of emotional maturity available today, where you are able to observe your feelings rather than becoming consumed by them. This creates space for understanding to develop naturally over time.

Energy
Energetically, this is a day that supports stillness, awareness, and grounding. Pluto retrograde does not push for action, it invites observation. Your energy may feel slower or more inward, which is supportive for this kind of internal recalibration.
It is helpful to stay connected to your body and your environment, as this keeps you anchored while deeper shifts begin to take place beneath the surface. Gentle routines and simple, grounding activities can support your energy throughout the day.

Relationships
In relationships, there may be a growing awareness of dynamics that have been operating quietly in the background. You may begin to recognise patterns around control, balance, or emotional exchange in a new way.
This is not a day for confronting everything at once. It is a day for noticing, understanding, and allowing clarity to build. When you see something clearly, your relationship to it begins to change naturally.

Work and Purpose
In your work and purpose, this energy supports deeper reflection around where your energy is being invested and whether it aligns with your long-term direction. You may begin to question certain structures or systems, especially if they no longer feel aligned with who you are becoming.
This is a time for observation rather than immediate change. Insight gained now will guide more aligned decisions moving forward.

Spiritual Growth
Spiritually, this is a powerful moment of inner transformation. Pluto retrograde invites you to turn inward and explore the deeper layers of your experience, especially those connected to identity, power, and alignment with your truth.
Growth here is subtle but profound. It unfolds through awareness, honesty, and the willingness to sit with what is real.

Collective Energy
Collectively, Pluto retrograde in Aquarius begins a period of reflection around systems, communities, and collective identity. There may be a gradual shift in how power is understood and expressed within the wider world, with more focus on internal change before external restructuring takes place.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
The most aligned way to move through today is by allowing yourself to slow down and become aware of what is shifting beneath the surface. You do not need to force change. You are beginning to understand where it is needed, and that awareness is where real transformation begins.

2027-01.title: 7 May – Integration & Steady Alignment
2027-01.guidance:
✦ The Energy of the Day: Settling, Awareness, and Quiet Progress
Today carries a calm, grounded energy that supports settling into everything that has recently shifted. With the Moon continuing through Capricorn, there is an emotional steadiness that helps you stay focused, present, and connected to what is in front of you.
Following the deeper internal shifts of yesterday’s Pluto retrograde, this is a day where things begin to land in a more practical way. This is something you feel in your body, in your reactions, and in the moments where you are invited to respond differently than you have before.

What makes this powerful is the opportunity to move with awareness. You may notice moments where you feel triggered or uncertain, and within those moments there is a choice. You can respond from the old pattern, or you can take a different step, one that supports who you are becoming.

The New Moon in Taurus follows closely, offering a steady and supportive space to begin again. Taurus energy is calm, rooted, and focused on what is real and sustainable. This is not about quick change. This is about creating something that can grow over time.
New Moons are always a point of reset, a moment where new intentions can be planted. In Taurus, those intentions are connected to stability, security, self-worth, and the way you build your life in a way that feels supportive and aligned.
There is a strong connection here between what you value and what you choose to create. You may feel more aware of what truly matters to you, what feels worth your time and energy, and what kind of life you want to build moving forward.
This is a beautiful energy for setting intentions that are grounded, realistic, and deeply aligned with who you are.

There is a sense of moving forward, although it comes through awareness and intention rather than force. You may feel a strong pull to do things differently, to choose yourself more fully, and to build something that reflects your true values rather than old patterns.

Spiritual Growth
Spiritually, this is a moment where healing and growth come together. You are not being asked to separate your past from your future. You are being invited to build from a place of awareness.
Growth here is grounded, embodied, and deeply personal.

Collective Energy
Collectively, this energy highlights themes of healing, value, and rebuilding. There may be a stronger focus on what is sustainable, what is supportive, and how to move forward in a way that feels aligned with deeper truths.

✦ New Moon Ritual: The Rite of Grounded Creation
This ritual is designed to work with the steady, building energy of the Taurus New Moon, while gently integrating the healing awareness brought forward by Mars conjunct Chiron.
This is about what you are ready to grow.

Preparation
Create a space that feels calm, comfortable, and sensory. Taurus energy responds to environment, so this matters.
You will need:
• One candle
• Something natural such as a plant, flowers, soil, or a stone
• A small piece of fabric, blanket, or something soft
• Pen and paper
• Optional, something grounding to engage the senses such as essential oil, perfume, or a warm drink
Take a moment to make your space feel good. This is part of the ritual.

☾ Step 1: Arriving in the Body
Sit comfortably and bring your awareness into your body. Feel where you are physically. Notice your breath, your posture, the weight of your body where it meets the ground.
Place one hand on your heart and one on your body, allowing yourself to fully arrive in the moment.
This is where Taurus begins, in presence.

☾ Step 2: Acknowledging What You Are Moving Beyond
Gently write down any patterns or fears that have recently come into your awareness, especially anything that felt activated by Mars conjunct Chiron.
You are not releasing this dramatically. You are simply recognising it.
Read it back quietly and place the paper to the side. There is no need to destroy it. Awareness is enough.

☾ Step 3: Setting Grounded Intentions
On a new piece of paper, write your intentions for what you are ready to build.
Focus on:
• Stability
• Self-worth
• Money, security, or resources
• What you want your life to feel like day to day
Keep it real. Keep it achievable. Taurus works with what can actually grow.

☾ Step 4: Anchoring the Intention into the Physical World
Place your intentions underneath your candle or next to your natural object.
If you are using soil or a plant, you can gently place your hands into the soil or hold the plant while reading your intentions.
As you do this, imagine your intentions taking root, slowly and steadily, building over time.
This is not fast growth. This is lasting growth.

☾ Step 5: Sensory Integration
Engage one of your senses intentionally.
Take a sip of your drink slowly, notice the taste
Apply a scent and breathe it in
Touch something soft and feel its texture
This step anchors your intentions into your body, not just your mind.

☾ Step 6: Closing the Ritual
Sit quietly for a few moments and allow everything to settle.
Blow out the candle slowly, holding the feeling of stability and trust.
Your intentions are something you are building.

✦ Taurus Altar Guidance
Keep this simple, grounded, and sensory:
• A candle for stability and focus
• Something natural such as flowers, plants, or soil
• Crystals such as green aventurine, jade, rose quartz, or moss agate
• Something soft or comforting like fabric or a blanket
• A scent or oil that feels calming and luxurious
This is an altar that feels good to sit with.

2027-01.title: 17 May - KEY TRANSIT - Mercury enters Gemini Mental Movement, Communication & New Ideas
2027-01.guidance:
✦ Mercury Enters Gemini: Curiosity, Communication, and Mental Expansion
Mercury moves into Gemini, bringing a noticeable shift in the pace and style of your thinking. After the slower, more grounded rhythm of Mercury in Taurus, this energy begins to open things up mentally, creating more movement, curiosity, and flexibility.
Thoughts begin to flow more freely. Ideas come more quickly. Conversations feel lighter, more dynamic, and more engaging. There is a natural desire to explore, to learn, and to connect with different perspectives.
Gemini energy thrives on variety and mental stimulation. You may find yourself drawn to new information, new conversations, and new ways of thinking about things that have recently felt more fixed or settled. There is less need to hold onto one single answer and more openness to exploring multiple possibilities.
This shift can feel refreshing, especially after the grounding energy of Taurus. Your mind becomes more adaptable, which supports problem solving, creativity, and communication.

✦ The Energy of the Day: Lightness, Curiosity, and Forward Flow
With the Moon, Venus, and Mars all in Taurus, there is still a strong grounding influence underneath this mental movement. This creates a really supportive balance where your mind is active and open, while your energy remains steady and anchored.
The Taurus influence helps you stay connected to what feels real and aligned, preventing the Gemini energy from becoming scattered. You are able to explore ideas while still maintaining a sense of direction.
Jupiter in Gemini amplifies this mental expansion even further, encouraging curiosity, learning, and openness to new opportunities. There is a strong sense of possibility in the air, although it is not something that needs to be rushed.
Mars in Taurus supports steady action, helping you move at a pace that feels sustainable. Saturn in Pisces continues to anchor you in what feels meaningful, while Pluto retrograde in Aquarius keeps deeper transformation working quietly in the background.
This is a day where your mind opens up, your perspective expands, and new ideas begin to take shape.

✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Stay curious and open to new ideas
✓ Engage in conversations that inspire you
✓ Explore different perspectives
✓ Allow your thinking to be flexible
✓ Follow what captures your interest

DON’T
𐄂 Overload yourself with too much information
𐄂 Scatter your focus across too many things
𐄂 Dismiss ideas too quickly
𐄂 Feel like you need to have all the answers
𐄂 Lose connection with what feels grounded

✦ How to Work With It
Emotions
Emotionally, there is a steadiness from the Taurus Moon that helps you stay grounded, even as your mind becomes more active. You may feel more balanced between thinking and feeling, which supports a calm and clear emotional state.
There is space to explore your thoughts without becoming disconnected from yourself. This allows you to stay present while also opening up to new perspectives.

Energy
Energetically, this is a day that supports both mental movement and steady action. You may feel more energised when you allow yourself to engage with ideas, conversations, and learning, while still staying anchored in your physical environment.
There is a natural flow between thinking and doing, which makes it easier to move forward in a way that feels aligned.

Relationships
In relationships, communication becomes more open and engaging. You may find conversations flow more easily, especially when there is curiosity and willingness to understand different perspectives.
This is a supportive time for connecting, sharing ideas, and expressing yourself in a way that feels natural and light.

Work and Purpose
This is a strong day for brainstorming, communication, and exploring new opportunities. Ideas can come through quickly, and you may feel more inspired to think differently about your direction.
There is also support for turning ideas into action, especially with the grounding Taurus influence helping you stay focused.

Spiritual Growth
Spiritually, this is about expanding your awareness through learning, curiosity, and openness. Growth comes through exploring new perspectives and allowing your understanding to evolve.
You are being invited to stay open rather than fixed.

Collective Energy
Collectively, there is a shift toward communication, information, and connection. The energy supports learning, sharing ideas, and exploring new ways of thinking.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
The most aligned way to move through today is by staying curious, open, and engaged, while allowing your ideas to develop in a way that feels grounded and aligned.

2027-01.title: 18 May - KEY TRANSIT - Mercury conjunct Uranus, Mars enters Taurus
2027-01.guidance:
✦ Mercury Conjunct Uranus: Sudden Insight and Mental Breakthroughs
Mercury meets Uranus in the early degrees of Gemini, bringing a surge of insight, awareness, and mental clarity that can feel sudden and unexpected. This is the kind of energy that shifts your perspective quickly, where something clicks into place or you begin to see a situation in a completely different way.
Uranus works through awakening, disruption, and change, while Mercury governs your thoughts, communication, and understanding. When these two come together, your mind opens in a way that allows new ideas to come through, often outside of your usual way of thinking.
There can be flashes of inspiration, intuitive downloads, or conversations that change the way you see something. You may find yourself thinking more creatively, more freely, and more independently, without feeling tied to old perspectives or expectations.
This energy does not follow a straight line. It moves quickly, often bringing clarity in moments rather than through slow processing. It is helpful to stay open and flexible, allowing ideas to come through without needing to immediately define them.
There is something exciting about this energy. It brings movement to the mind and opens up new possibilities.

✦ Mars Enters Taurus: Steady Action and Lasting Momentum
Later in the day, Mars moves into Taurus, shifting the way you take action into something more grounded, consistent, and intentional. This is a noticeable change in pace, moving away from emotional reactivity and into something that feels more steady and controlled.
Mars in Taurus is not fast, although it is powerful. It supports action that is deliberate, patient, and focused on long-term results. There is a stronger connection to what feels worth your energy, and less interest in anything that feels rushed or unstable.
This energy helps you build momentum in a way that lasts. It supports consistency, commitment, and the willingness to keep going even when things are moving slowly.
There is also a strong connection to the physical world here. Action becomes more tangible, more embodied, and more connected to your environment and your resources.

✦ Together: Insight Meets Action
Together, these two transits create a powerful flow between mental breakthrough and grounded action. You may experience a moment of clarity or inspiration, followed by a sense of how to move forward in a way that feels steady and real.
There is an opportunity here to take new ideas and begin anchoring them into something tangible. You are not just thinking differently, you are beginning to move differently.
This creates a really supportive bridge between vision and reality.

✦ The Energy of the Day: Movement, Clarity, and Building Something Real
With the Sun, Venus, and Mars now in Taurus by the end of the day, there is a strong grounding influence supporting everything that is coming through. The Moon moving through Taurus adds to this, creating a steady emotional foundation underneath the mental shifts.
Mercury and Jupiter in Gemini keep the mind open, curious, and active, while Saturn in Pisces continues to anchor you in what feels meaningful. Uranus in Taurus remains in the background, supporting longer-term change and evolution.
This is a day where ideas begin to take shape in a way that feels usable. You are able to think differently and then begin building something from that place.

✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Pay attention to sudden insights and ideas
✓ Stay open to thinking differently
✓ Take grounded action on what feels aligned
✓ Focus on consistency rather than speed
✓ Trust the connection between insight and action

DON’T
𐄂 Dismiss ideas just because they feel unexpected
𐄂 Rush into action without grounding yourself
𐄂 Scatter your energy across too many directions
𐄂 Hold onto old ways of thinking out of habit
𐄂 Expect everything to happen instantly

✦ How to Work With It
Emotions
Emotionally, there is a steady and grounded feeling developing throughout the day. The Taurus influence helps you stay connected to yourself, even as your mind becomes more active and open. You may feel more secure in your emotional responses, which allows you to move through the day with a sense of calm awareness.
There is space to process what is coming through without becoming overwhelmed, which supports a balanced emotional state.

Energy
Energetically, this is a day that begins with mental activation and moves into physical grounding. You may feel bursts of inspiration earlier in the day, followed by a stronger sense of focus and determination as the energy settles.
This is supportive for taking ideas and beginning to work with them in a practical way. Your energy responds well to steady, intentional action.

Relationships
In relationships, communication can feel more dynamic and engaging, especially earlier in the day. Conversations may bring new perspectives or unexpected insights that shift understanding.
As the day progresses, there is a stronger focus on stability and consistency, which supports building trust through actions rather than just words.

Work and Purpose
This is a powerful day for combining ideas with action. You may receive insights or inspiration that can be applied in a practical way, especially when you take your time and focus on what feels sustainable.
This is supportive energy for beginning to build something, even if it starts with small steps.

Spiritual Growth
Spiritually, this is about integrating awareness with action. Insight becomes meaningful when it is grounded into your reality, and this energy supports that process.
You are being invited to move with what you are learning.

Collective Energy
Collectively, there is a blend of innovation and grounding. New ideas and perspectives begin to emerge, while there is also a focus on building something stable and lasting from those shifts.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
The most aligned way to move through today is by staying open to insight and allowing yourself to take steady, grounded action on what feels aligned.

2027-01.title: 19 May - KEY TRANSIT - Venus enters Cancer Emotional Connection, Softness & Heart-Led Alignment
2027-01.guidance:
✦ Venus Enters Cancer: Nurturing Love and Emotional Security
As Venus moves into Cancer, there is a clear shift in how you connect, relate, and experience love, both with others and within yourself. The energy softens, becoming more emotionally aware, more protective, and more focused on what feels safe and meaningful.
Venus in Cancer values emotional security, comfort, and genuine connection. This is not surface level interaction. This is about feeling held, understood, and supported within your relationships. You may find yourself becoming more aware of what you need emotionally, as well as what you are willing to give.
There is a natural pull toward home, familiarity, and environments that feel nurturing. You may feel more drawn to creating comfort in your space, strengthening close relationships, or simply spending time in ways that feel emotionally fulfilling.
This energy also brings awareness to emotional boundaries. When you are more connected to your feelings, you are also more aware of what feels supportive and what does not. This supports more conscious choices in how you give and receive.

✦ The Energy of the Day: Grounded Comfort and Emotional Awareness
With the Moon, Sun, and Mars all in Taurus, there is a strong grounding influence supporting this emotional shift. This creates a really stable and calming energy, allowing you to feel more deeply while still remaining anchored in your body and your environment.
Mercury and Jupiter in Gemini keep communication and curiosity flowing, although there is a softer tone to how you express yourself. There is more awareness of how words are received, and more care in how you communicate.
Saturn in Pisces continues to bring emotional maturity and depth, helping you stay steady within your feelings rather than becoming overwhelmed by them. Pluto retrograde in Aquarius remains in the background, continuing deeper internal shifts.
This is a day where emotional awareness and stability work together in a way that feels supportive and reassuring.

✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Prioritise what feels emotionally supportive
✓ Create comfort in your space and environment
✓ Strengthen connections that feel safe and aligned
✓ Honour your emotional needs
✓ Move with care and intention

DON’T
𐄂 Ignore your emotional boundaries
𐄂 Overgive from a place of obligation
𐄂 Stay in environments that feel draining
𐄂 Dismiss what you are feeling
𐄂 Expect yourself to be emotionally available to everyone

✦ How to Work With It
Emotions
Emotionally, this is a deeply supportive day for reconnecting with yourself. You may feel more aware of your needs, your sensitivities, and what brings you a sense of comfort and security.
There is a softness to this energy that allows you to feel without pressure. When you honour what you are feeling, you create a stronger sense of emotional stability.

Energy
Energetically, this is a calm and grounding day. The Taurus influence keeps you steady, while Venus in Cancer encourages you to move in ways that feel nurturing and supportive.
You may feel more aligned when you prioritise comfort, rest, and environments that feel safe.

Relationships
In relationships, there is a strong focus on emotional connection and care. You may feel more drawn to deeper, more meaningful interactions, and less interested in anything that feels surface level.
This is a supportive time for strengthening bonds, expressing care, and creating a sense of emotional safety within your connections.

Work and Purpose
In your work, this energy supports creating an environment that feels supportive and aligned. You may feel more productive when you are comfortable and emotionally settled.
This is also a good time to reflect on whether your work feels fulfilling on a deeper level.

Spiritual Growth
Spiritually, this is about connecting to yourself through feeling. Growth comes through honouring your emotions and allowing them to guide you in a grounded and supportive way.

Collective Energy
Collectively, there is a shift toward emotional awareness, care, and connection. There may be a stronger focus on home, family, and what creates a sense of security and belonging.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
The most aligned way to move through today is by prioritising what feels emotionally supportive and allowing yourself to move through the day with care, softness, and intention.

2027-01.title: 20 May - Balance & Steady Flow
2027-01.guidance:
✦ The Energy of the Day: Comfort, Stability, and Emotional Ease
Today carries a calm, grounded energy that feels steady and supportive. With the Moon, Sun, and Mars all in Taurus, there is a strong emphasis on stability, simplicity, and moving through the day at a pace that feels natural and manageable.
After the emotional shift of Venus entering Cancer, this energy helps you settle into what feels good. There is less urgency, less pressure, and more of a focus on creating comfort in your environment and within yourself. You may feel more drawn to routines, familiar spaces, and activities that bring a sense of ease.
This is an energy that supports consistency rather than intensity. You are not being pushed to do more. You are being supported in doing what feels aligned in a steady and sustainable way.
Mercury and Jupiter in Gemini keep your mind open and engaged, although there is no pressure to act on every idea. Thoughts can flow in the background while your energy remains grounded in the present moment.
Venus in Cancer continues to soften your emotional world, encouraging you to prioritise what feels nurturing and supportive. Mars in Taurus helps you take action in a way that feels steady and controlled, allowing progress to unfold without force.
Saturn in Pisces adds a quiet depth, helping you stay connected to what feels meaningful, while Pluto retrograde in Aquarius continues to support deeper internal shifts beneath the surface.
This is a day where everything begins to feel more settled. There is something very reassuring about this energy.

✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Focus on what feels calm and manageable
✓ Create comfort in your environment
✓ Move at a pace that feels natural to you
✓ Stay consistent with what matters
✓ Allow yourself to enjoy the present moment

DON’T
𐄂 Rush yourself unnecessarily
𐄂 Overcomplicate simple things
𐄂 Take on more than you need to
𐄂 Ignore your need for rest or comfort
𐄂 Feel like you should be doing more

✦ How to Work With It
Emotions
Emotionally, there is a sense of calm and steadiness today. You may feel more settled within yourself, which allows you to move through the day with ease.

Energy
Energetically, this is a grounded and supportive day. You may feel most aligned when you keep things simple and move at a steady pace.

Relationships
In relationships, there is a focus on comfort and emotional support. You may feel more drawn to connection that feels safe and easy.

Work and Purpose
This is a good day for steady progress and maintaining consistency. You may feel more productive when you focus on what is already in motion.

Spiritual Growth
Spiritually, this is about grounding your awareness into your everyday life. Growth comes through consistency and presence.

Collective Energy
Collectively, there is a focus on stability, comfort, and steady movement. The energy supports building in a way that feels sustainable.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
The most aligned way to move through today is by keeping things simple, steady, and supportive, allowing yourself to move in a way that feels calm and aligned.

2027-01.title: 21 May - KEY TRANSIT - Sun enters Gemini Expansion, Curiosity & New Mental Cycles
2027-01.guidance:
✦ Sun Enters Gemini: A New Cycle of Movement, Learning, and Connection
The Sun moves into Gemini, marking the beginning of a new energetic cycle that brings movement, curiosity, and a noticeable shift in pace. After the grounded, steady energy of Taurus season, this transition begins to open things up mentally and socially.
Gemini energy is curious, adaptable, and focused on communication, learning, and connection. There is a natural desire to explore, to ask questions, and to engage with the world in a more active and open way. You may find your mind becoming busier, ideas flowing more easily, and a stronger pull toward conversations, information, and new experiences.
This is not about locking into one path or one way of thinking. This is about exploring possibilities, staying open, and allowing your understanding to evolve. There is a lightness to this energy that supports movement and flexibility, while still allowing you to stay connected to what feels meaningful.
With Mercury and Jupiter already in Gemini, this shift is amplified. There is a strong emphasis on thought, communication, and expansion, which can bring new ideas, new opportunities, and a sense of forward movement.
This is the beginning of a cycle that invites you to stay curious and engaged with what is unfolding around you.

✦ The Energy of the Day: Opening Up While Staying Grounded
With the Moon and Mars still in Taurus, there is a grounding influence supporting this shift. This creates a really balanced energy where your mind is opening up, while your body and your actions remain steady.
Venus in Cancer continues to bring emotional awareness and softness into the day, helping you stay connected to what feels supportive and aligned within your relationships.
Saturn in Pisces adds depth and meaning, reminding you to stay connected to what matters while you explore new ideas. Uranus in Taurus continues to support longer-term change, while Pluto retrograde in Aquarius works quietly in the background, deepening your internal awareness.
This creates a supportive balance between movement and stability. You are able to explore, think, and connect, while still staying grounded in what feels real and aligned.

✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Stay curious and open to new ideas
✓ Engage in conversations and learning
✓ Allow yourself to explore different perspectives
✓ Stay flexible in your thinking
✓ Follow what feels interesting and engaging

DON’T
𐄂 Try to lock yourself into one fixed direction
𐄂 Overwhelm yourself with too much information
𐄂 Scatter your energy across everything at once
𐄂 Ignore what feels meaningful
𐄂 Force clarity before it naturally forms

✦ How to Work With It
Emotions
Emotionally, there is a lightness beginning to come through, although it is supported by the grounding influence of the Taurus Moon. You may feel more open, more curious, and more willing to engage, while still feeling stable within yourself.
There is space to experience your emotions without becoming weighed down by them. You are able to move through what you feel while staying connected to a broader perspective, which supports a more balanced emotional state.

Energy
Energetically, this is a day where movement begins to increase, especially mentally. You may feel more energised by conversation, learning, and engaging with new ideas. At the same time, the Taurus influence helps you stay steady, which allows you to use this energy in a way that feels controlled and intentional.
This is a supportive time to begin opening things up, especially if you have been feeling slow or restricted. You are not being asked to do everything at once. You are being invited to explore and allow your energy to move more freely.

Relationships
In relationships, communication becomes more important. You may feel more open to talking, sharing, and connecting in a way that feels lighter and more natural. There is less intensity and more flow, which can make interactions feel easier and more enjoyable.
This is a good time to reach out, to have conversations, and to connect with people who stimulate your mind as well as support your emotional world.

Work and Purpose
In your work, this energy supports new ideas, brainstorming, and exploring different directions. You may feel more inspired to think outside of your usual patterns, which can open up new possibilities.
This is not about committing to everything you think of. It is about allowing ideas to come through and beginning to explore what feels aligned. There is value in staying flexible and open as things begin to develop.

Spiritual Growth
Spiritually, this is a shift toward awareness through observation and curiosity. Growth comes through engaging with new perspectives, asking questions, and allowing your understanding to expand.
There is something powerful about staying open. You do not need to have all the answers. You are being invited to explore.

Collective Energy
Collectively, there is a shift toward communication, information, and connection. There may be a stronger focus on sharing ideas, learning, and engaging with the world in a more active way.
This energy supports movement, curiosity, and the exchange of information on a wider scale.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
The most aligned way to move through today is by staying open, curious, and engaged, allowing yourself to explore what is unfolding while staying grounded in what feels aligned.

2027-01.title: 22 May - KEY TRANSIT - Sun conjunct Uranus Awakening, Change & Sudden Realisations
2027-01.guidance:
✦ Sun Conjunct Uranus: Awakening, Freedom, and Unexpected Shifts
The Sun meets Uranus, bringing a surge of awakening energy that can feel sudden, electric, and impossible to ignore. This is the kind of transit that shifts perspective quickly, often through insight, realisation, or unexpected change.
Uranus represents disruption, innovation, and liberation. When it aligns with the Sun, your awareness sharpens in a way that highlights where change is needed. You may recognise something that no longer feels aligned, or feel a strong pull toward something new that reflects who you are becoming.
This is not a slow unfolding. This energy moves quickly, often bringing clarity in moments. It can feel exciting, freeing, and at times unpredictable, as it breaks you out of patterns that have become too fixed.
There is a strong theme of individuality here. You may feel more connected to your own truth, less willing to conform, and more open to doing things in a way that feels authentic to you.

✦ The Energy of the Day: Mental Expansion and Electric Movement
With the Sun, Moon, Mercury, and Jupiter all in Gemini, there is a strong emphasis on the mind, communication, and movement. This amplifies the Uranian energy, making the day feel fast-paced, mentally active, and full of possibility.
Thoughts can move quickly, ideas can come through in bursts, and conversations may bring unexpected insight. There is a sense of expansion, although it works best when you allow things to unfold rather than trying to control the direction.
Mars in Taurus provides a grounding influence, helping you stay steady even as things shift. Venus in Cancer continues to bring emotional awareness, ensuring that you remain connected to what feels supportive and aligned.
Saturn in Pisces adds a layer of depth, helping you stay connected to meaning while navigating change. Pluto retrograde in Aquarius continues to support deeper internal transformation.
This creates a dynamic balance between movement and grounding, allowing you to experience change without losing your centre.

✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Stay open to new ideas and unexpected shifts
✓ Trust sudden insights and realisations
✓ Allow yourself to think differently
✓ Embrace change where it feels aligned
✓ Stay flexible and adaptable

DON’T
𐄂 Resist change out of habit
𐄂 Overwhelm yourself with too many possibilities
𐄂 React impulsively without grounding
𐄂 Dismiss ideas that feel unfamiliar
𐄂 Try to control everything

✦ How to Work With It
Emotions
Emotionally, this can feel like a mix of excitement and unpredictability. You may notice sudden shifts in how you feel about something, especially if a new awareness comes through. There is space to experience these changes without needing to fully define them straight away.
Staying connected to your body and your breath helps you remain steady as things shift internally. There is something supportive about allowing emotions to move naturally rather than trying to hold them in place.

Energy
Energetically, this is a high movement day, especially mentally. You may feel bursts of energy, inspiration, or restlessness, which can be channelled into exploring ideas, having conversations, or making small shifts in your routine.
Grounding becomes important here. When you stay connected to your body and your environment, you are able to use this energy in a way that feels exciting rather than overwhelming.

Relationships
In relationships, conversations can feel more open, honest, and revealing. You may gain new insight into dynamics or feel more confident expressing yourself in a way that feels true.
There can also be a need for space or independence, which supports healthier connection when it is honoured. This is about allowing relationships to evolve naturally rather than holding them in a fixed way.

Work and Purpose
This is a powerful day for ideas, innovation, and thinking outside of your usual patterns. You may receive insights that shift how you approach something, especially when you allow yourself to explore new directions.
There is also support for making changes, although these work best when they are grounded rather than impulsive. Small shifts can create meaningful movement.

Spiritual Growth
Spiritually, this is an awakening energy. Growth comes through awareness, through recognising what is no longer aligned, and through allowing yourself to step into something new.
This is about aligning more fully with your truth.

Collective Energy
Collectively, there is a strong emphasis on change, innovation, and new ways of thinking. There may be unexpected developments, shifts in perspective, or increased focus on individuality and freedom.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
The most aligned way to move through today is by staying open to change, trusting what comes through, and allowing yourself to move with the energy rather than against it.

2027-01.title: 23 May - Integration & Mental Flow
2027-01.guidance:
✦ The Energy of the Day: Processing, Clarity, and Light Movement
Today carries a lighter, more flowing energy that supports processing everything that has recently shifted. With the Sun, Moon, Mercury, and Jupiter all in Gemini, there is a strong focus on the mind, communication, and understanding.
After the sudden awareness and movement of yesterday, this is a day where things begin to make more sense. Thoughts can organise themselves more naturally, and you may find it easier to connect the dots between what has come up and what it means for you moving forward.
There is a natural curiosity present, although it feels calmer and more settled. You are able to explore ideas without feeling overwhelmed by them, which creates a sense of mental clarity and ease.
Mars in Taurus continues to ground your actions, helping you stay steady while your mind remains active. Venus in Cancer keeps you connected to your emotional world, ensuring that your thoughts stay aligned with what feels supportive and meaningful.
Saturn in Pisces adds depth and quiet structure, while Pluto retrograde in Aquarius continues to support deeper internal awareness beneath the surface.
This is a day where understanding deepens gently. You are not being pushed. You are being supported in making sense of what is unfolding.

✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Give yourself space to process and reflect
✓ Stay open to understanding things in a new way
✓ Engage in conversations that bring clarity
✓ Allow your thoughts to flow naturally
✓ Keep things light and manageable

DON’T
𐄂 Overload yourself with too much information
𐄂 Rush to make final decisions
𐄂 Overanalyse every detail
𐄂 Dismiss subtle insights
𐄂 Push yourself unnecessarily

✦ How to Work With It
Emotions
Emotionally, there is a lightness that allows you to move through your feelings with more ease. You may feel less attached to intensity and more able to observe what is coming up.

Energy
Energetically, this is a mentally active but balanced day. You may feel most aligned when you allow yourself to think, talk, and explore without pressure.

Relationships
In relationships, communication flows more easily. Conversations can bring clarity, understanding, and a sense of connection.

Work and Purpose
This is a supportive day for planning, organising ideas, and exploring different options. You may feel more productive when you stay flexible.

Spiritual Growth
Spiritually, this is about understanding and integration. Growth comes through making sense of what you are experiencing.

Collective Energy
Collectively, there is a focus on communication, learning, and shared understanding. The energy supports connection and exchange.

✦ Best Use of This Energy
The most aligned way to move through today is by allowing yourself to process, reflect, and move with a sense of lightness and curiosity.

2027-01.title: 24 May - Emotional Flow & Creative Connection
2027-01.guidance:

2027-01.title: 31 May - Full Moon in Sagittarius
2027-01.guidance:
✦ The Full Moon in Sagittarius: Expansion, Truth, and Forward Vision
This Full Moon brings a sense of expansion, openness, and forward movement that feels very different to the emotional depth of the earlier part of the month. Sagittarius energy lifts your perspective, helping you step back from the details and reconnect with the bigger picture of your life.
There is a strong focus on truth here. Not in a confrontational way, but in a way that brings clarity around what feels aligned, what feels meaningful, and what direction you are being guided toward. You may notice a deeper awareness of what you want moving forward, especially in areas connected to growth, purpose, and possibility.
Sagittarius is connected to belief, direction, and the way you see the world. Under this Full Moon, you may begin to recognise where your perspective has shifted, where you have outgrown certain ways of thinking, and where you are ready to move into something new.
Full Moons bring completion and illumination. In Sagittarius, that illumination often comes through insight, realisation, and a sense of inner knowing about what comes next.
There is a feeling of movement here. Not rushed, not forced, but guided.

✦ The Energy of the Day: Perspective, Clarity, and Expansion
With the Sun in Gemini opposing the Moon in Sagittarius, there is a balance between information and meaning, between what you know and what you believe. This creates a really supportive space for understanding, where you are able to connect the details with the bigger picture.
Mercury and Jupiter in Gemini continue to keep your mind active, helping you process information and stay open to different perspectives. The Sagittarius Moon brings this into a wider view, helping you understand what it all means for you.
Venus in Cancer keeps you connected to your emotional world, ensuring that your decisions feel aligned with what is supportive and meaningful. Mars in Taurus grounds your actions, helping you move forward in a steady and intentional way.
Saturn in Pisces adds depth and awareness, while Pluto retrograde in Aquarius continues to support deeper internal transformation.
This is a day where understanding expands. You are able to see further, feel clearer, and move with more confidence in your direction.

✦ Dos and Don’ts
DO
✓ Reflect on what you have learned this month
✓ Stay open to new perspectives and possibilities
✓ Trust what feels true for you
✓ Allow yourself to think bigger
✓ Move toward what feels aligned

DON’T
𐄂 Limit yourself based on past thinking
𐄂 Overanalyse every detail
𐄂 Ignore what feels expansive and exciting
𐄂 Rush into decisions without grounding
𐄂 Dismiss your inner knowing

✦ How to Work With It
Emotions
Emotionally, there is a sense of openness and expansion today. You may feel lighter, more hopeful, and more connected to what is possible. There is something uplifting about this energy that helps you move beyond anything that has been feeling heavy.
At the same time, there can be moments of realisation as you see things more clearly. These insights feel supportive, helping you understand where you are and where you are heading.

Energy
Energetically, this is a day that supports movement and forward thinking. You may feel more energised when you allow yourself to think bigger, explore ideas, and step outside of your usual routine.
There is a natural flow between insight and action here, especially when you stay grounded in what feels aligned.

Relationships
In relationships, there is a focus on honesty and understanding. You may feel more open to expressing your truth and more willing to see things from a broader perspective.
This can support meaningful conversations and a deeper sense of alignment within your connections.

Work and Purpose
This is a powerful day for reflecting on your direction and where you are heading. You may gain insight into what feels aligned and what you are ready to move toward.
There is support for thinking bigger and allowing yourself to explore new possibilities, especially in areas connected to growth and purpose.

Spiritual Growth
Spiritually, this is a moment of expansion. Growth comes through understanding, perspective, and the willingness to move beyond old limitations.
You are being invited to trust what feels true for you and to allow your path to open in a natural way.

Collective Energy
Collectively, there is a focus on truth, expansion, and wider perspective. There may be a stronger awareness around beliefs, direction, and the need to move forward in a more aligned way.

✦ Full Moon Ritual: The Rite of Expansion, Truth, and Forward Vision
This ritual is designed to work with the expansive, truth-seeking energy of the Sagittarius Full Moon. This is about releasing limitation, reconnecting with your direction, and opening yourself up to what is next.
This is not just reflection. This is realignment with your path.
Preparation
Create a space that feels open, light, and freeing. If you can, do part of this near a window, outside, or somewhere you can see the sky.

You will need:
• One candle
• Pen and paper
• Something that represents expansion, this could be a map, a book, a passport, or anything symbolic of growth and exploration
• Optional, incense or a scent that feels uplifting such as frankincense or citrus
Take a moment to open your space physically. Sagittarius energy responds to openness.

☾ Step 1: Opening the Space
Light your candle and stand or sit with your chest open and your posture lifted.
Take a few deep breaths and bring your awareness to your body. Feel your energy expand with each inhale.
Say quietly, “I am open to truth, growth, and new direction.”

☾ Step 2: Releasing Limiting Beliefs
Write down the beliefs, fears, or perspectives that feel restrictive or outdated.
Focus on things that have been keeping you small, doubting yourself, or limiting your vision.
Read them back slowly, then tear the paper. If you can, safely burn it or release it outside, allowing that energy to leave your space.
This is about freeing your mind as much as your energy.

☾ Step 3: Expanding Your Vision
On a new piece of paper, write freely about where you are going.
Not just goals, but direction.
What kind of life you want to live
What you want to experience
What feels expansive, exciting, and aligned
Let yourself think bigger than you normally would. Sagittarius energy supports this.

☾ Step 4: Speak It Into Reality
Read your vision out loud.
This is important. Sagittarius is connected to voice, truth, and expression.
Let yourself hear what you are stepping into. Let it feel real in your body.

☾ Step 5: Anchor Through Movement
Move your body in some way, even if it is just stretching, walking, or stepping outside for a few minutes.
Sagittarius energy is not static. It integrates through movement.
As you move, hold the feeling of expansion and direction within you.

☾ Step 6: Closing the Ritual
Come back to stillness and take a few breaths.
Blow out the candle slowly, holding a sense of trust in where you are going.

✦ Sagittarius Altar Guidance
Keep this light, open, and symbolic of expansion:
• A candle for truth and clarity
• A map, book, or travel-related object
• Crystals such as green aventurine, jade, rose quartz, or moss agate
• Incense or scent that feels uplifting and expansive
• Anything that represents growth, learning, or new experiences
This is an altar that feels open and inspiring.

The emotional high point of the month arrives with the Full Moon in Aries on 26 September. Aries Full Moons bring courage, momentum and decisive action. They illuminate where you are ready to trust yourself more fully, release hesitation and move forwards with greater confidence. This is a powerful moment to recognise just how much you've grown and allow that growth to shape the choices you make next.
The final days of September continue building momentum as Mars enters Leo on 28 September, followed by Mercury entering Scorpio on 30 September. Mars in Leo reignites confidence, creativity and visibility, encouraging you to lead with your heart and proudly share your talents. Mercury's move into Scorpio then invites deeper conversations, stronger intuition and a desire to understand life beyond the surface. Together, they create a beautiful balance between bold action and thoughtful reflection.
Throughout September, the True North Node in Aquarius continues guiding us towards the future. Every courageous conversation, every confident decision and every small act of authenticity becomes another step towards the life you're creating. Aquarius reminds us that lasting change begins the moment we stop trying to fit into old versions of ourselves and start embracing who we are becoming.
September is ultimately a month of quiet transformation becoming visible. The confidence you've been building begins to show in your choices, your voice and the way you carry yourself. By the end of the month, you may realise that the greatest shift has been the relationship you've built with yourself, because that is the foundation every future dream will grow from.

October feels like a month of rediscovery. September encouraged you to move forwards with greater confidence, and October invites you to look more closely at the values, desires and relationships guiding those choices. With both Venus and Mercury beginning retrograde journeys, the astrology brings old feelings, unfinished conversations and previous decisions back into view so that you can understand them from the person you are today.
We begin the month in Libra season, where relationships, balance and the way we share our lives with other people remain central. Libra encourages us to notice how our connections influence the choices we make and whether the agreements within them still feel fair, supportive and aligned. This month brings an opportunity to create greater harmony through self-awareness, clearer standards and a deeper understanding of what mutuality means to you.
✦ This month invites you to...
✨ Reconsider what love, success and fulfilment mean to you.
✨ Create relationships built through honesty and mutual effort.
✨ Recover ideas and desires that still hold genuine value.
✨ Strengthen the foundations that help you feel safe and supported.
✨ Make choices that reflect everything you now understand about yourself.
One of the most significant shifts arrives on 3 October, when Venus stations retrograde in Scorpio. Relationships, money, intimacy, trust and self-worth enter a powerful period of reflection. Old desires and emotional patterns may return to awareness, allowing you to understand what has been influencing your choices beneath the surface. This retrograde encourages a more honest relationship with what you value and what you need in order to feel secure within yourself and your connections.
Mercury meets retrograde Venus in Scorpio on 7 October, creating an important moment for conversations, memories and emotional realisations. Something you previously struggled to explain may finally find language, while an old exchange could take on a completely different meaning. This aspect supports thoughtful honesty and helps us recognise where our feelings, values and words need to become more closely aligned.
The New Moon in Libra arrives on 10 October, opening a new lunar cycle centred around relationships, collaboration and shared agreements. With Venus retrograde ruling this lunation, the intentions we set are shaped by everything currently being reconsidered. This New Moon encourages us to create healthier dynamics, establish more intentional standards and give our relationships enough honesty and structure to grow.
As the month continues, Pluto stations direct in Aquarius on 16 October, bringing a gradual shift within the collective. Themes surrounding technology, community, influence and the future begin moving from internal reflection towards visible development. You may become more aware of the role you want to play within a group, cause or changing system, especially when your personal evolution has altered the future you want to help create.
The energy deepens when the Sun enters Scorpio on 23 October. Scorpio season encourages focus, emotional courage and the willingness to explore what lies beneath appearances. Trust, intimacy, shared resources and personal transformation become increasingly important, helping us strengthen what deserves to remain and address the patterns that can no longer be ignored.
The following day brings two powerful turning points. The Sun meets retrograde Venus in Scorpio on 24 October, illuminating something important about love, money, desire or self-worth. This conjunction can bring a valuable realisation within the Venus retrograde journey, helping you understand how your priorities have changed. Later that morning, Mercury stations retrograde in Scorpio, beginning a deeper investigation into unresolved conversations, missing information and decisions that require greater context.
Venus then returns to Libra on 25 October, carrying everything discovered in Scorpio back into the way we relate, create and present ourselves. This stage of the retrograde encourages refinement across relationships, personal style, creative work and the environments we inhabit. You may feel ready to restore something with lasting value, update an old dynamic or make the outer expression of your life reflect the person you have become within it.
The emotional high point of the month arrives with the Full Moon in Taurus on 26 October. This lunation illuminates money, security, self-worth, physical wellbeing and the tangible results of our choices. Taurus invites us to recognise what is already supporting us and define what genuine sufficiency feels like. Something built through patience may reach completion, helping you appreciate how much stability has been created through steady, consistent effort.
Throughout October, Mars continues travelling through Leo, bringing creative courage and the desire to act from the heart. This fire helps balance the month’s reflective astrology by reminding you to keep participating in your life while deeper realisations unfold. Confidence grows through using your talents, expressing your ideas and allowing your choices to carry more of your personality.
October is ultimately a month of returning to what matters with greater self-knowledge. Relationships, desires and decisions may be revisited, giving you the opportunity to choose again from a wiser and more emotionally aware place. By the end of the month, you may understand that rediscovery can be its own form of transformation, because seeing something differently allows you to meet it as the person you have become.

November feels like a month of finding your direction again. October brought relationships, desires and decisions back into view, and November gives you opportunities to use what you have discovered. With Mercury and Venus turning direct around the middle of the month, conversations may gradually become clearer, preferences feel easier to honour and plans begin finding their next step. There is a growing sense of possibility, especially when you recognise how much your understanding has changed.
We begin in Scorpio season, where trust, intimacy, shared resources and emotional honesty remain important. You may feel ready to acknowledge a desire you have kept private or understand why a particular situation has held so much of your attention.
